ekb-u5e001bd1c1d651ad46-1.text: OF THE URBAN OKRUG MUNICIPALITY “CITY OF YEKATERINBURG”

ekb-u081e51ba02ba504991-1.text: The Yekaterinburg City Duma, expressing the interests of the residents of the City of Yekaterinburg, conscious of its responsibility for organizing city life, respecting Yekaterinburg’s historical and cultural traditions, and guided by the Constitution of the Russian Federation, federal and oblast laws and other regulatory legal acts governing the exercise of local self-government in the Russian Federation, adopts this Charter governing the organization of local self-government in the Urban Okrug Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”.

ekb-uba45a015dd9eec3415-1.text: The City of Yekaterinburg, founded in 1723, forms part of Sverdlovsk Oblast and, in accordance with its Charter, is the administrative centre of Sverdlovsk Oblast.

ekb-u5a338c902f97f9d6bd-1.text: The second paragraph was repealed by Decision of the Yekaterinburg City Duma of 22.11.2022 No. 57/81.

ekb-u0bd2a708df09c743fe-1.text: Article 2. Urban Okrug Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”
ekb-u0bd2a708df09c743fe-1.locator: Article 2. Urban Okrug Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”

ekb-u57313338c9ad528452-1.text: 1. In accordance with federal and oblast legislation, the Urban Okrug Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg” is an urban okrug.
ekb-u57313338c9ad528452-1.locator: Article 2. Urban Okrug Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”

ekb-ufc47e2c273a8950bd0-1.text: 2. The name of the municipality is the Urban Okrug Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”. The abbreviated name of the municipality is the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”.
ekb-ufc47e2c273a8950bd0-1.locator: Article 2. Urban Okrug Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”

ekb-uc8231d474319e03b40-1.text: 3. In the official symbols of the Urban Okrug Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”, municipal legal acts and other cases requiring the name of the municipality to be stated, the abbreviated name may be used on an equal basis with the name defined in the first paragraph of point 2 of this Article.
ekb-uc8231d474319e03b40-1.locator: Article 2. Urban Okrug Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”

ekb-ucbb0953289b040d1f4-1.text: 4. For the purposes of this Charter, the terms “Urban Okrug Municipality ‘City of Yekaterinburg’”, “Municipality ‘City of Yekaterinburg’” and “municipality” are used as equivalent terms.
ekb-ucbb0953289b040d1f4-1.locator: Article 2. Urban Okrug Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”

ekb-uba0f9f99fc18c16fc6-1.text: 1. The territory of the municipality consists of settlement land, adjoining land for common use, recreational land and land for the development of the municipality.

ekb-u86546a91bc27494bfc-1.text: 2. The municipality comprises the following settlements: the City of Yekaterinburg; the settlements of Berezit, Zelyony Bor, Istok, Medny, Michurinsky, Moskovsky, Palkinsky Torfyanik, Polevodstvo, Sadovy, Severka, Sovkhozny, Sysert, Chusovskoye Ozero, Shabrovsky, Shirokaya Rechka and Shuvakish; and the villages of Verkhnemakarovo and Gorny Shchit.

ekb-u75d55e901e3a107b3e-1.text: 3. For administrative purposes, the territory of the municipality is divided into 8 administrative-territorial units — city districts: Akademichesky, Verkh-Isetsky, Zheleznodorozhny, Kirovsky, Leninsky, Oktyabrsky, Ordzhonikidzevsky and Chkalovsky.

ekb-u33d1c7c20c73bce8b4-1.text: A city district is not a municipality.

ekb-uca3224d53bf902c69f-1.text: 1. The boundaries of the municipality are established by a law of Sverdlovsk Oblast.

ekb-u4ebceeadecb6d0908c-1.text: 2. The boundaries of the municipality are changed by a law of Sverdlovsk Oblast on the initiative of the population, local self-government bodies of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”, state authorities of Sverdlovsk Oblast or federal state authorities, in accordance with federal legislation.

ekb-u82abd278062f0b6ba4-1.text: 3. A change to the boundaries of the municipality that transfers the territories of individual settlements within it to the territories of other municipalities is carried out with the consent of the population of the municipality, expressed by the Yekaterinburg City Duma in accordance with federal legislation.

ekb-u0eb0efbb404a322571-1.text: Article 5. Population of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”
ekb-u0eb0efbb404a322571-1.locator: Article 5. Population of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”

ekb-u04806684de8d810ca1-1.text: 1. The population of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg” consists of citizens of the Russian Federation residing in its territory on the grounds established by applicable legislation. The population of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg” may, in accordance with the procedure established by law, exercise local self-government through local referendums, municipal elections and other forms of direct expression of will, and through the Yekaterinburg City Duma, the Head of Yekaterinburg and the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg.
ekb-u04806684de8d810ca1-1.locator: Article 5. Population of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”

ekb-u305324dcd6f6551adb-1.text: 1-1. The population residing in the territory of the municipality and united by common interests in addressing matters of local significance constitutes the local community.
ekb-u305324dcd6f6551adb-1.locator: Article 5. Population of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”

ekb-ud7dc06f3ae37cb9129-1.text: 2. In accordance with federal legislation, foreign citizens permanently residing in the territory of the municipality have the right, on the basis of international treaties of the Russian Federation and in accordance with the established procedure, to elect and be elected to local self-government bodies of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg” and to participate in a local referendum.
ekb-ud7dc06f3ae37cb9129-1.locator: Article 5. Population of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”

ekb-ub2fc10ff9d202e2a20-1.text: 3. Foreign citizens permanently or predominantly residing in the territory of the municipality have the right, in accordance with international treaties of the Russian Federation, to exercise local self-government in other forms established by federal law.
ekb-ub2fc10ff9d202e2a20-1.locator: Article 5. Population of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”

ekb-u46abd6f8584b88dfac-1.text: Article 6. Local self-government bodies of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”
ekb-u46abd6f8584b88dfac-1.locator: Article 6. Local self-government bodies of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”

ekb-u2c8f0d453e3d6d59d3-1.text: 1. The representative body of the municipality is the Yekaterinburg City Duma (hereinafter referred to as the City Duma).
ekb-u2c8f0d453e3d6d59d3-1.locator: Article 6. Local self-government bodies of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”

ekb-u9563f70d675075c366-1.text: 2. The highest official of the municipality is the Head of Yekaterinburg.
ekb-u9563f70d675075c366-1.locator: Article 6. Local self-government bodies of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”

ekb-ue947c97ee438a44c81-1.text: 3. The executive and administrative body of the municipality is the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg.
ekb-ue947c97ee438a44c81-1.locator: Article 6. Local self-government bodies of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”

ekb-ud18b4b409e5b07cd00-1.text: 4. The control and accounts body of the municipality is the Chamber of Accounts of the City of Yekaterinburg (hereinafter referred to as the Chamber of Accounts).
ekb-ud18b4b409e5b07cd00-1.locator: Article 6. Local self-government bodies of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”

ekb-u9b2ea245b75314618f-1.text: Article 7. Official symbols of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”
ekb-u9b2ea245b75314618f-1.locator: Article 7. Official symbols of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”

ekb-u71645819d15848d6f5-1.text: 1. The Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg” has official symbols, the regulations on which are approved by decisions of the City Duma.
ekb-u71645819d15848d6f5-1.locator: Article 7. Official symbols of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”

ekb-u4bde599a7fd6f33446-1.text: 2. Official symbols are subject to state registration in accordance with the procedure established by federal legislation.
ekb-u4bde599a7fd6f33446-1.locator: Article 7. Official symbols of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”

ekb-u9d74a406ca3dedc3ca-1.text: 3. The procedure for using official symbols is established by a decision of the City Duma.
ekb-u9d74a406ca3dedc3ca-1.locator: Article 7. Official symbols of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”

ekb-ud339f381a4ea574530-1.text: 4. By a decision of the City Duma on the proposal of the Head of Yekaterinburg, honorary titles and badges may be established for merits that have received broad recognition among the population of the municipality.
ekb-ud339f381a4ea574530-1.locator: Article 7. Official symbols of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”

ekb-u356bcc285761166b78-1.text: Chapter II. COMPETENCE OF THE MUNICIPALITY
ekb-u356bcc285761166b78-1.locator: Chapter II. COMPETENCE OF THE MUNICIPALITY

ekb-uf53b1f4c632c0daf25-1.locator: Chapter II. COMPETENCE OF THE MUNICIPALITY

ekb-u2e9c14ed59a4cb81c8-1.text: Article 8. Competence of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”
ekb-u2e9c14ed59a4cb81c8-1.locator: Article 8. Competence of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”

ekb-u8eb000ccaac1ea94f3-1.text: The competence of the municipality consists of matters of local significance of the municipality; the powers of local self-government bodies and officials to address such matters and exercise individual state powers transferred by federal laws and laws of Sverdlovsk Oblast; and the rights of the municipality’s local self-government bodies to address matters not classified as matters of local significance of the municipality.
ekb-u8eb000ccaac1ea94f3-1.locator: Article 8. Competence of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”

ekb-u4925de066ac192be66-1.text: Article 9. Matters of local significance of the municipality
ekb-u4925de066ac192be66-1.locator: Article 9. Matters of local significance of the municipality

ekb-u847f3ceed57dfb460f-1.text: 1. Matters of local significance are matters directly supporting the daily life of the population of the municipality, which, in accordance with the Constitution of the Russian Federation and federal legislation, are addressed independently by the population and/or local self-government bodies of the municipality.
ekb-u847f3ceed57dfb460f-1.locator: Article 9. Matters of local significance of the municipality

ekb-u6aca7a73f0e91060dc-1.text: 2. Matters of local significance of the municipality include:
ekb-u6aca7a73f0e91060dc-1.locator: Article 9. Matters of local significance of the municipality

ekb-uf9ac00e2ebdb84234c-1.text: 1) comprehensive socioeconomic development of the municipality;
ekb-uf9ac00e2ebdb84234c-1.locator: Article 9. Matters of local significance of the municipality

ekb-ufda6d19b532239641a-1.text: 2) preparing and considering the draft municipal budget, approving and executing the municipal budget, monitoring its execution, and preparing and approving the report on execution of the municipal budget;
ekb-ufda6d19b532239641a-1.locator: Article 9. Matters of local significance of the municipality

ekb-u6ac63aa15f32d18cf5-1.text: 3) introducing, amending and abolishing the municipality’s local taxes and levies;
ekb-u6ac63aa15f32d18cf5-1.locator: Article 9. Matters of local significance of the municipality

ekb-uf463e65e6fe30be737-1.text: 4) possession, use and disposal of municipally owned property;
ekb-uf463e65e6fe30be737-1.locator: Article 9. Matters of local significance of the municipality

ekb-ucc45375a4eb8b207d7-1.text: 5) organizing electricity, heat, gas and water supply, wastewater disposal and fuel supply for the population within the municipality’s boundaries, within the powers established by the legislation of the Russian Federation;
ekb-ucc45375a4eb8b207d7-1.locator: Article 9. Matters of local significance of the municipality

ekb-u5961b6cbe88f8c4a1d-1.text: 5-1) exercising municipal oversight of the unified heat supply organization’s fulfilment of obligations to construct, reconstruct and/or modernize heat supply facilities;
ekb-u5961b6cbe88f8c4a1d-1.locator: Article 9. Matters of local significance of the municipality

ekb-u2a96cd056f8d91b666-1.text: 6) road activities in relation to roads of local significance within the municipality’s boundaries and ensuring road traffic safety on them, including establishing and maintaining the operation of parking facilities (parking spaces); exercising municipal oversight of road transport, urban surface electric transport and road infrastructure within the municipality’s boundaries; organizing road traffic; and exercising other powers concerning the use of roads and road activities in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation;
ekb-u2a96cd056f8d91b666-1.locator: Article 9. Matters of local significance of the municipality

ekb-u48760162a951ea5608-1.text: 7) providing housing to low-income citizens residing in the municipality who need residential premises; organizing the construction and maintenance of municipal housing stock; creating conditions for housing construction; exercising municipal housing oversight and other powers of local self-government bodies in accordance with housing legislation;
ekb-u48760162a951ea5608-1.locator: Article 9. Matters of local significance of the municipality

ekb-u7ea35ddb0b0fb60d7f-1.text: 8) creating conditions for providing transport services to the population and organizing transport services for the population within the municipality’s boundaries;
ekb-u7ea35ddb0b0fb60d7f-1.locator: Article 9. Matters of local significance of the municipality

ekb-u375f138fd7ef0cffca-1.text: 8-1) participating in the prevention of terrorism and extremism and in minimizing and/or eliminating the consequences of manifestations of terrorism and extremism within the municipality’s boundaries;
ekb-u375f138fd7ef0cffca-1.locator: Article 9. Matters of local significance of the municipality

ekb-ua853c3dabc5051e2c9-1.text: 8-2) developing and implementing measures aimed at strengthening interethnic and interfaith harmony, supporting and developing the languages and cultures of the peoples of the Russian Federation residing in the municipality, realizing the rights of indigenous small-numbered peoples and other national minorities, ensuring migrants’ social and cultural adaptation, and preventing conflicts between nationalities (ethnic groups);
ekb-ua853c3dabc5051e2c9-1.locator: Article 9. Matters of local significance of the municipality

ekb-u91ec92f410a38a7b35-1.text: 9) participating in the prevention of emergencies and elimination of their consequences within the municipality’s boundaries;
ekb-u91ec92f410a38a7b35-1.locator: Article 9. Matters of local significance of the municipality

ekb-u38d919c210beade80c-1.text: 10) organizing the maintenance of public order in the municipality’s territory by the municipal militia;
ekb-u38d919c210beade80c-1.locator: Article 9. Matters of local significance of the municipality

ekb-u034de69796de6c41e9-1.text: 10-1) providing premises for an officer holding the position of district police commissioner to work in the administrative precinct of the municipality served by that officer;
ekb-u034de69796de6c41e9-1.locator: Article 9. Matters of local significance of the municipality

ekb-u539c13a0b2e6a692f1-1.text: 10-2) until 1 January 2017, providing housing to an officer holding the position of district police commissioner and the officer’s family members for the period during which the officer performs the duties of that position;
ekb-u539c13a0b2e6a692f1-1.locator: Article 9. Matters of local significance of the municipality

ekb-u9a74396190d9dee128-1.text: 11) ensuring primary fire safety measures within the municipality’s boundaries;
ekb-u9a74396190d9dee128-1.locator: Article 9. Matters of local significance of the municipality

ekb-u9be6a01f600a7d405f-1.text: 12) organizing environmental protection measures within the municipality’s boundaries, including organizing and conducting, in accordance with environmental protection legislation, public discussions of planned economic and other activities in the municipality’s territory;
ekb-u9be6a01f600a7d405f-1.locator: Article 9. Matters of local significance of the municipality

ekb-u3078e393af3db48c17-1.text: 13) repealed by Decision of the Yekaterinburg City Duma of 26.09.2006 No. 61/28;
ekb-u3078e393af3db48c17-1.locator: Article 9. Matters of local significance of the municipality

ekb-u324c44cc348f690ccd-1.text: 14) organizing universally accessible, free preschool, primary general, basic general and secondary general education under core general education programmes in municipal educational organizations (except powers to finance implementation of core general education programmes in accordance with federal state educational standards); organizing supplementary education for children in municipal educational organizations (except supplementary education for children financed by the state authorities of Sverdlovsk Oblast); organizing supplementary education for adults under supplementary sports training programmes in municipal educational organizations; creating conditions for the supervision, care and maintenance of children in municipal educational organizations; and, within its powers, implementing measures to ensure the organization of children’s recreation during school holidays, including measures to ensure the safety of their lives and health;
ekb-u324c44cc348f690ccd-1.locator: Article 9. Matters of local significance of the municipality

ekb-u519149b6d06f739c14-1.text: 15) creating conditions for providing medical care to the population in the municipality’s territory (except municipal territories included in the list approved by the Government of the Russian Federation of territories whose populations receive medical care in medical organizations subordinate to the federal executive authority responsible for medical and sanitary services for the population of particular territories), in accordance with the territorial programme of state guarantees of free medical care for citizens;
ekb-u519149b6d06f739c14-1.locator: Article 9. Matters of local significance of the municipality

ekb-ube8ba3872b70e49c0e-1.text: 16) creating conditions for providing the municipality’s residents with communications, catering, retail and household services;
ekb-ube8ba3872b70e49c0e-1.locator: Article 9. Matters of local significance of the municipality

ekb-u7a9218793ee27f888c-1.text: 17) organizing library services for the population, developing the collections of the municipality’s libraries and ensuring their preservation;
ekb-u7a9218793ee27f888c-1.locator: Article 9. Matters of local significance of the municipality

ekb-uded0f90d5ec434ccf3-1.text: 18) creating conditions for organizing leisure activities and providing the municipality’s residents with services of cultural organizations;
ekb-uded0f90d5ec434ccf3-1.locator: Article 9. Matters of local significance of the municipality

ekb-uc4fb30c684985c5b50-1.text: 19) preserving, using and promoting cultural heritage sites (historical and cultural monuments) owned by the municipality, and protecting cultural heritage sites (historical and cultural monuments) of local (municipal) significance located in its territory;
ekb-uc4fb30c684985c5b50-1.locator: Article 9. Matters of local significance of the municipality

ekb-uf9ddf99200d53482ca-1.text: 20) ensuring conditions for the development of physical culture, school sports and mass sports in the municipality’s territory, and organizing official physical fitness, health and sporting events of the municipality;
ekb-uf9ddf99200d53482ca-1.locator: Article 9. Matters of local significance of the municipality

ekb-u6b1396c852e273cd54-1.text: 21) creating conditions for mass recreation for the municipality’s residents and organizing the provision of facilities at public recreation areas;
ekb-u6b1396c852e273cd54-1.locator: Article 9. Matters of local significance of the municipality

ekb-uad67b9d7204fdefa48-1.text: 22) repealed with effect from 1 January 2008 by Decision of the Yekaterinburg City Duma of 22.05.2007 No. 28/42;
ekb-uad67b9d7204fdefa48-1.locator: Article 9. Matters of local significance of the municipality

ekb-uc09a34a7c55ea951f0-1.text: 23) establishing and maintaining the municipal archive;
ekb-uc09a34a7c55ea951f0-1.locator: Article 9. Matters of local significance of the municipality

ekb-uc62bdb60ef7489a8c1-1.text: 24) organizing funeral services and maintaining burial grounds;
ekb-uc62bdb60ef7489a8c1-1.locator: Article 9. Matters of local significance of the municipality

ekb-ue9186de2752ff60123-1.text: 25) participating in organizing activities for the accumulation (including separate accumulation), collection, transportation, processing, recovery, neutralization and landfilling of municipal solid waste;

ekb-u06305e9dc074e0b09b-1.text: Article 10. Powers of the municipality’s local self-government bodies
ekb-u06305e9dc074e0b09b-1.locator: Article 10. Powers of the municipality’s local self-government bodies

ekb-u9d6b1f1f0cbe858814-1.text: 1. For the purpose of addressing matters of local significance, the municipality’s local self-government bodies have the following powers:
ekb-u9d6b1f1f0cbe858814-1.locator: Article 10. Powers of the municipality’s local self-government bodies

ekb-ub70fc1d8e463f966de-1.text: 1) adopting the municipal charter, amending and supplementing it, and issuing municipal legal acts;
ekb-ub70fc1d8e463f966de-1.locator: Article 10. Powers of the municipality’s local self-government bodies

ekb-u5ff6dfdf0150a109f1-1.text: 2) establishing official symbols of the municipality;
ekb-u5ff6dfdf0150a109f1-1.locator: Article 10. Powers of the municipality’s local self-government bodies

ekb-u755807da4fdc5da5d3-1.text: 3) establishing municipal enterprises and institutions, financing the activities of municipal treasury-funded institutions and the performance of municipal assignments by municipal budgetary and autonomous institutions, and procuring goods, works and services to meet municipal needs;

ekb-uda9e8b908b28426cbd-1.text: 4) setting tariffs for services provided and work performed by municipal enterprises and institutions, unless otherwise provided by federal laws;
ekb-uda9e8b908b28426cbd-1.locator: Article 10. Powers of the municipality’s local self-government bodies

ekb-u7c703b752b5ee8b9bf-1.text: 5) repealed by Decision of the Yekaterinburg City Duma of 19.11.2019 No. 47/25;
ekb-u7c703b752b5ee8b9bf-1.locator: Article 10. Powers of the municipality’s local self-government bodies

ekb-ub2f8122068596eab5d-1.text: 5-1) powers to organize heat supply provided for by the Federal Law ‘On Heat Supply’;
ekb-ub2f8122068596eab5d-1.locator: Article 10. Powers of the municipality’s local self-government bodies

ekb-u3ce62ab3d48cacbed3-1.text: 5-2) powers in the field of water supply and wastewater disposal provided for by the Federal Law ‘On Water Supply and Wastewater Disposal’;
ekb-u3ce62ab3d48cacbed3-1.locator: Article 10. Powers of the municipality’s local self-government bodies

ekb-u575311fdf9475d5412-1.text: 5-3) powers in the field of strategic planning provided for by Federal Law of 28 June 2014 No. 172-ФЗ ‘On Strategic Planning in the Russian Federation’;
ekb-u575311fdf9475d5412-1.locator: Article 10. Powers of the municipality’s local self-government bodies

ekb-u9c26345a7b64f89f06-1.locator: Article 10. Powers of the municipality’s local self-government bodies

ekb-u13813e088e24e02ebf-1.text: 7-2) developing and approving programmes for the comprehensive development of the municipality’s utility infrastructure systems, transport infrastructure and social infrastructure, the requirements for which are established by the Government of the Russian Federation;
ekb-u13813e088e24e02ebf-1.locator: Article 10. Powers of the municipality’s local self-government bodies

ekb-ucd169e9a6731cb1b82-1.text: 8) conducting international and foreign economic relations in accordance with Federal Law of 6 October 2003 No. 131-ФЗ ‘On the General Principles of the Organization of Local Self-Government in the Russian Federation’;
ekb-ucd169e9a6731cb1b82-1.locator: Article 10. Powers of the municipality’s local self-government bodies

ekb-u24de036b71a2489366-1.text: 9) establishing a print media outlet and/or an online publication to promulgate municipal legal acts and communicate official information to the municipality’s residents;
ekb-u24de036b71a2489366-1.locator: Article 10. Powers of the municipality’s local self-government bodies

ekb-u80cbfef5f55259ac3a-1.locator: Article 10. Powers of the municipality’s local self-government bodies

ekb-u091d3aa78f4f5a12b5-1.text: 2. ekb-u091d3aa78f4f5a12b5-1.locator: Article 10. Powers of the municipality’s local self-government bodies

ekb-ud1f3feaf47b0f0a0eb-1.text: Only work that does not require specialized professional training may be classified as work of social significance.
ekb-ud1f3feaf47b0f0a0eb-1.locator: Article 10. Powers of the municipality’s local self-government bodies

ekb-u25b9b8b7df3b1ed761-1.text: Adult residents of the municipality who are able to work are involved in work of social significance without remuneration, outside their principal work or study time, no more than once every three months. Such work may last no more than four consecutive hours.
ekb-u25b9b8b7df3b1ed761-1.locator: Article 10. Powers of the municipality’s local self-government bodies

ekb-u1491c2555f3230ead9-1.text: 3. The powers of local self-government bodies established by federal law and this Charter are exercised independently.
ekb-u1491c2555f3230ead9-1.locator: Article 10. Powers of the municipality’s local self-government bodies

ekb-u4e519080eb4364d14b-1.text: Article 11. Exercise of individual state powers by the municipality’s local self-government bodies
ekb-u4e519080eb4364d14b-1.locator: Article 11. Exercise of individual state powers by the municipality’s local self-government bodies

ekb-u0653b654c8ff8d2037-1.text: 1. Individual state powers are vested in the municipality’s local self-government bodies by federal laws and laws of Sverdlovsk Oblast.
ekb-u0653b654c8ff8d2037-1.locator: Article 11. Exercise of individual state powers by the municipality’s local self-government bodies

ekb-uee7e929b3598c59994-1.text: 2. Local self-government bodies may be vested with individual state powers for an unlimited period or, where those powers have a specified duration, for the duration of those powers.
ekb-uee7e929b3598c59994-1.locator: Article 11. Exercise of individual state powers by the municipality’s local self-government bodies

ekb-ua26704108b1ee864b4-1.text: 3. Individual state powers transferred to local self-government bodies are financed solely through subventions provided to the municipal budget from the federal and oblast budgets.
ekb-ua26704108b1ee864b4-1.locator: Article 11. Exercise of individual state powers by the municipality’s local self-government bodies

ekb-ubd56dcf5deafbb72f5-1.text: 3-1. To protect the municipality’s interests and improve the effectiveness of the exercise of individual state powers transferred to them, local self-government bodies may additionally use their own material resources and financial funds to exercise those powers if the City Duma adopts the corresponding decision.
ekb-ubd56dcf5deafbb72f5-1.locator: Article 11. Exercise of individual state powers by the municipality’s local self-government bodies

ekb-u0fa4c0609e2e4a4a92-1.text: A decision to use additional own funds and material resources to exercise individual state powers transferred to local self-government bodies, specifying the amount of funds, the list of material resources, and the justification and procedure for their use, is adopted by the City Duma annually before the beginning of the next financial year (during the financial year), on the proposal of the Head of Yekaterinburg.
ekb-u0fa4c0609e2e4a4a92-1.locator: Article 11. Exercise of individual state powers by the municipality’s local self-government bodies

ekb-u7f5e999b542af9d899-1.text: 4. Local self-government bodies bear responsibility for exercising individual state powers according to the procedure established by the relevant federal and oblast laws, within the material resources and funds allocated to the municipality for those purposes.
ekb-u7f5e999b542af9d899-1.locator: Article 11. Exercise of individual state powers by the municipality’s local self-government bodies

ekb-u04ddca9299cc972f22-1.text: 5. Local self-government bodies participate in the exercise of state powers not transferred to them in accordance with Article 19 of Federal Law of 6 October 2003 No. 131-ФЗ ‘On the General Principles of the Organization of Local Self-Government in the Russian Federation’ if the City Duma adopts a decision to exercise the right to participate in those powers.
ekb-u04ddca9299cc972f22-1.locator: Article 11. Exercise of individual state powers by the municipality’s local self-government bodies

ekb-ub62780f063eae3ecbb-1.text: Chapter III. FORMS OF DIRECT EXERCISE BY THE POPULATION
ekb-ub62780f063eae3ecbb-1.locator: Chapter III. FORMS OF DIRECT EXERCISE BY THE POPULATION

ekb-uc95398839b5befe73b-1.text: OF LOCAL SELF-GOVERNMENT AND PARTICIPATION OF THE POPULATION
ekb-uc95398839b5befe73b-1.locator: Chapter III. FORMS OF DIRECT EXERCISE BY THE POPULATION

ekb-uff127ccfc1b71e342f-1.text: IN THE EXERCISE OF LOCAL SELF-GOVERNMENT
ekb-uff127ccfc1b71e342f-1.locator: Chapter III. FORMS OF DIRECT EXERCISE BY THE POPULATION

ekb-ua8c2180cce56438c45-1.text: Article 11-1. Forms of direct exercise of local self-government by the population of the municipality and participation of the population of the municipality in the exercise of local self-government
ekb-ua8c2180cce56438c45-1.locator: Chapter III. FORMS OF DIRECT EXERCISE BY THE POPULATION

ekb-u3879217cf0fb3424f3-1.text: 1. Forms of direct exercise of local self-government by the population of the municipality include: local referendums; municipal elections; and votes to recall the Head of Yekaterinburg.
ekb-u3879217cf0fb3424f3-1.locator: Chapter III. FORMS OF DIRECT EXERCISE BY THE POPULATION

ekb-ua6814fc2dd91bb8119-1.text: 2. Forms of participation of the population of the municipality in the exercise of local self-government include: votes on changing the municipality’s boundaries or transforming the municipality; citizens’ assemblies; citizens’ law-making initiatives; initiative projects; territorial public self-government; the headperson of a rural settlement; public hearings; public discussions; citizens’ meetings; citizens’ conferences (meetings of delegates); citizens’ surveys; citizens’ appeals to the municipality’s local self-government bodies; the Civic Chamber of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”; and other forms provided for by federal laws and laws of Sverdlovsk Oblast, this Charter and other municipal legal acts.
ekb-ua6814fc2dd91bb8119-1.locator: Chapter III. FORMS OF DIRECT EXERCISE BY THE POPULATION

ekb-u030bc3d03ea5505654-1.text: 1. A local referendum may be held for the population of the municipality to address matters of local significance directly.

ekb-u9958e57278a6911447-1.text: 2. A local referendum is held on the basis of universal, equal and direct expression of will by secret ballot.

ekb-ue0e09a2f283e37c4bc-1.text: The decision to call a local referendum is adopted by the City Duma on the initiative of the entities specified by federal law.

ekb-uffce377352a64cb887-1.text: 3. The procedure for calling and holding a local referendum and determining its results is established by a law of Sverdlovsk Oblast.

ekb-uec725fe9fa0972c407-1.text: The registration certificate issued to an initiative group for a local referendum is valid from the day following registration of that initiative group until the day the local referendum campaign ends, as determined in accordance with the federal law establishing basic guarantees of the right of citizens of the Russian Federation to participate in referendums.

ekb-u1686d812ab282fe8af-1.text: The registration certificate issued to another group of participants in a local referendum is valid from the day following registration of that other group until the day the local referendum campaign ends, as determined in accordance with the federal law establishing basic guarantees of the right of citizens of the Russian Federation to participate in referendums.

ekb-u2c8a7a0f082dab86b0-1.text: 4. The voting totals and the decision adopted in a local referendum are subject to official publication (promulgation).

ekb-u03a9e369bddaa7ff46-1.text: Municipal regulatory legal acts adopted in a local referendum are forwarded by the Head of Yekaterinburg for publication in the official print publication designated for official publication (promulgation) of City Duma decisions.

ekb-ub78caa4af190ec6d3b-1.text: 5. A decision adopted in a local referendum is binding throughout the municipality’s territory and does not require approval by state authorities, local self-government bodies or their officials.

ekb-ua42fac0ea6f71fc59b-1.text: A local referendum may not be held within two years from official publication of the results of a local referendum with a question formulated to have the same meaning.

ekb-uda9175900dfa83adea-1.text: 6. Guarantees of citizens’ rights to participate in a local referendum are established by federal law.

ekb-u48a685f44b7655e468-1.text: 1. Municipal elections are held to elect deputies of the City Duma on the basis of universal, equal and direct suffrage by secret ballot.

ekb-uc8394258fbef194834-1.text: 2. Repealed by Decision of the Yekaterinburg City Duma of 12.10.2010 No. 62/29.

ekb-u9a89ab391803021571-1.text: 3. The procedure for calling, preparing and conducting municipal elections, establishing voting totals and determining election results, and guarantees of citizens’ electoral rights in those elections are established by federal law and a law of Sverdlovsk Oblast.

ekb-u851639ac2b4cde4177-1.text: 4. The voting totals and results of municipal elections are subject to official publication (promulgation).

ekb-u317172d85610c2d747-1.text: Article 14. Vote to recall the Head of Yekaterinburg
ekb-u317172d85610c2d747-1.locator: Article 14. Vote to recall the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u4bab6251d09c422ddd-1.text: 1. A vote to recall the Head of Yekaterinburg is held on the population’s initiative in accordance with the procedure established for local referendums by federal law and a law of Sverdlovsk Oblast, taking account of the special provisions of the federal law establishing the general principles of the organization of local self-government in the Russian Federation.
ekb-u4bab6251d09c422ddd-1.locator: Article 14. Vote to recall the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-uf10fa7ba377ce0e256-1.text: 2. The grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg are established by this Charter.
ekb-uf10fa7ba377ce0e256-1.locator: Article 14. Vote to recall the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u49cf9e5d6aed8b336f-1.text: 3. The procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg must ensure the Head’s right to explain to voters the circumstances put forward as grounds for recall.
ekb-u49cf9e5d6aed8b336f-1.locator: Article 14. Vote to recall the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u363a08ebac0aa29676-1.text: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg
ekb-u363a08ebac0aa29676-1.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u359fe28e263f1e206b-1.text: 1. The grounds for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg are:
ekb-u359fe28e263f1e206b-1.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u9268b0daf12592e7c6-1.text: 1) specific unlawful decisions, where confirmed through judicial proceedings;
ekb-u9268b0daf12592e7c6-1.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u039efcec40177ca71e-1.text: 2) repeated administrative offences (two or more times within a year) for which the law provides the penalty of administrative detention, where the person’s commission of those offences has been established through judicial proceedings;
ekb-u039efcec40177ca71e-1.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u9f06726ef6c89eef99-1.text: 3) failure to comply with the time limit for issuing a municipal legal act necessary to implement a decision adopted through direct expression of the population’s will.
ekb-u9f06726ef6c89eef99-1.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u81a8a56381b8b4092d-1.text: Paragraph deleted by Decision of the Yekaterinburg City Duma of 25.10.2011 No. 67/47.
ekb-u81a8a56381b8b4092d-1.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-ue88b765286348875bd-1.text: 2. The Head of Yekaterinburg is recalled by voting at polling stations.
ekb-ue88b765286348875bd-1.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-ue62004d1cc33407d84-1.text: 3. Lists of polling districts specifying their boundaries and the addresses and telephone numbers of precinct election commissions are published by the Head of Yekaterinburg in the mass media no later than 25 days before polling day.
ekb-ue62004d1cc33407d84-1.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u18fef8e43ea1a55ed2-1.text: 4. The initiative to hold a vote to recall the Head of Yekaterinburg belongs to persons entitled to participate in municipal elections who constitute at least five percent of the municipality’s registered voters.
ekb-u18fef8e43ea1a55ed2-1.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u8d5473570be30fbe26-1.text: 5. Any voter or group of voters entitled to participate in a recall vote may form a recall initiative group of at least 100 persons.
ekb-u8d5473570be30fbe26-1.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u3b201d19a2ba35e1a7-1.text: 6. The decision to establish an initiative group, its number of members and its individual membership is adopted by participants in a meeting of a group of citizens in accordance with the procedure provided for by a decision of that meeting.
ekb-u3b201d19a2ba35e1a7-1.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-uf2cd1067f73d7f94e9-1.text: Notice of the meeting is sent to the City Duma and to the person against whom a recall vote initiative may be launched no later than 5 days before the meeting.
ekb-uf2cd1067f73d7f94e9-1.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u03debd3fb554ee48fb-1.text: Before the meeting, participants are registered in writing, stating their surnames, given names, patronymics, dates of birth, residential addresses, and the series and numbers of their passports or documents replacing a citizen’s passport. Registration is confirmed by each participant’s personal signature.
ekb-u03debd3fb554ee48fb-1.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u97291ed84316c9db5f-1.text: The meeting must have at least 200 participants. Minutes are drawn up recording the decision adopted. The minutes state the date and place of the meeting, the number of participants, the substance of the matter considered, the voting results and decisions adopted, and the list of initiative group members with each member’s surname, given name, patronymic, date of birth, residential address, and the series and number of their passport or other identity document. The minutes are signed by the chair and secretary of the meeting. A list of meeting participants is attached to the minutes. The initiative group elects its own chair independently.
ekb-u97291ed84316c9db5f-1.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u54623a1af4e0c51428-1.text: Documents for registration of the initiative group are submitted no later than seven days after the meeting.
ekb-u54623a1af4e0c51428-1.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-uf78888c4c2452ee8a2-1.text: 7. The City Duma registers the initiative group to recall the Head of Yekaterinburg no later than 15 days after receiving the meeting minutes and the documents attached to them.
ekb-uf78888c4c2452ee8a2-1.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u04f8ec15b7a56be9dd-1.text: Registration of the initiative group may be refused only where the meeting procedure or deadlines for submitting registration documents established by this Charter have been breached.
ekb-u04f8ec15b7a56be9dd-1.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u6ce30343ba4acaec65-1.text: 8. Upon registering the initiative group, the City Duma issues its chair a registration certificate and permission to open a special temporary account for the initiative group’s support fund.
ekb-u6ce30343ba4acaec65-1.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u7576f81158f647e6d5-1.text: The forms of the initiative group registration certificate and permission to open a special temporary account for its support fund are approved by the City Duma. The initiative group registration certificate is valid for one month from its date of issue.
ekb-u7576f81158f647e6d5-1.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u486c34d8ceae714e12-1.text: 9. At the initiative group’s request, the Head of Yekaterinburg provides information on registered voters in accordance with the federal law establishing basic guarantees of the electoral rights of citizens of the Russian Federation.
ekb-u486c34d8ceae714e12-1.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-uc1e8d5323a9e1fc6bf-1.text: 10. Receipt of the initiative group registration certificate constitutes the basis for beginning collection of signatures in support of the proposal to hold a vote to recall the Head of Yekaterinburg. The initiative group bears the costs of collecting signatures.
ekb-uc1e8d5323a9e1fc6bf-1.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u693301628d38892fa5-1.text: Signatures are collected by completing signature sheets containing the proposal to hold a recall vote.
ekb-u693301628d38892fa5-1.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u29409a963d6896ab8d-1.text: 11. A citizen supporting the initiative to hold a recall vote personally enters their signature and the date of signing on the signature sheet, stating their surname, given name, patronymic, date of birth, residential address, and the series and number of their passport or document replacing a citizen’s passport.
ekb-u29409a963d6896ab8d-1.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-uac3b74daf099bce5d8-1.text: 12. A signature sheet supporting the proposal to hold a recall vote states:
ekb-uac3b74daf099bce5d8-1.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-ufc6a941e07133b73e0-1.text: 1) the name of the municipality in which signatures are being collected;
ekb-ufc6a941e07133b73e0-1.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u0413cecef39f664dc0-1.text: 2) the initiative group’s registration date and registration certificate number;
ekb-u0413cecef39f664dc0-1.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-ub258daadc887b72ea3-1.text: 3) the proposal to recall the Head of Yekaterinburg, stating the Head’s surname, given name and patronymic;
ekb-ub258daadc887b72ea3-1.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u8d4aed119ef14f697c-1.text: 4) the citizen’s surname, given name, patronymic, date of birth and residential address, and the series and number of their passport or document replacing a passport.
ekb-u8d4aed119ef14f697c-1.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u6809859675d68b4afb-1.text: Each signature sheet must be certified by the signatures of the person who collected citizens’ signatures and one initiative group member, stating the certification date and each of those persons’ surname, given name, patronymic, date of birth, residential address, and the series and number of their passport or document replacing a citizen’s passport.
ekb-u6809859675d68b4afb-1.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-ucb270a7a37c95e213a-1.text: 13. After signature collection ends, but no later than expiry of the initiative group registration certificate, the initiative group counts the total number of signatures and draws up a final record. The maximum number of signatures submitted may not exceed the number established by point 4 of this Article by more than five percent.
ekb-ucb270a7a37c95e213a-1.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u8df3543ea1f253abd1-1.text: The numbered and bound signature sheets and the original final record are delivered by representatives of the initiative group to the City Duma. Signature sheets completed in breach of the requirements of this Charter are not accepted.
ekb-u8df3543ea1f253abd1-1.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u60c249a8e9c3c47ca6-1.text: 14. Within ten days, the City Duma organizes verification of compliance with this Charter’s requirements in collecting signatures supporting a recall vote. Representatives of the initiative group may be present during verification of the signature sheets.
ekb-u60c249a8e9c3c47ca6-1.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-ub59a232daf11d649b1-1.text: The second paragraph was repealed with effect from 31 October 2022 by Decision of the Yekaterinburg City Duma of 09.08.2022 No. 26/76.
ekb-ub59a232daf11d649b1-1.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-ub5aea9f72391761913-1.text: 15. If this Charter’s requirements have not been observed in collecting signatures supporting a recall vote, the City Duma adopts a decision refusing to hold a vote to recall the Head of Yekaterinburg. That decision must be published (promulgated).
ekb-ub5aea9f72391761913-1.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-ua9a19437caa2895c7f-1.text: 16. If the City Duma adopts a decision to hold a vote to recall the Head of Yekaterinburg, the Head of Yekaterinburg, no later than 15 days after publication (promulgation) of that decision, submits a proposal to the City Duma to allocate municipal budget funds for organizing and holding the recall vote.
ekb-ua9a19437caa2895c7f-1.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u766bc930d097cf7444-1.text: 17. Precinct commissions for a recall vote are formed in accordance with the federal law establishing basic guarantees of the electoral rights of citizens of the Russian Federation and the law of Sverdlovsk Oblast adopted in accordance with it.
ekb-u766bc930d097cf7444-1.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u46df96509acb59a737-1.text: 18. Repealed with effect from 31 October 2022 by Decision of the Yekaterinburg City Duma of 09.08.2022 No. 26/76.
ekb-u46df96509acb59a737-1.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-uf988f1709cd0825944-1.text: 19. The Head of Yekaterinburg against whom recall proceedings have been initiated may participate in campaigning during the recall on the same terms as other citizens and give explanations concerning the circumstances put forward as grounds for recall, including during the meeting to establish the initiative group.
ekb-uf988f1709cd0825944-1.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-ub37dab1053d3c4733e-1.text: 20. Campaigning during the recall of the Head of Yekaterinburg is conducted:
ekb-ub37dab1053d3c4733e-1.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u11fec97217bd3dff73-1.text: 1) on television and radio broadcasters’ channels and in periodical print publications;
ekb-u11fec97217bd3dff73-1.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-uba0bc591abeeca1dc2-1.text: 2) through mass events (assemblies and meetings with citizens, rallies, demonstrations, marches, public debates and discussions);
ekb-uba0bc591abeeca1dc2-1.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u0f1201320ff70ef4f0-1.text: 3) through the production and distribution of printed, audiovisual and other campaign materials;
ekb-u0f1201320ff70ef4f0-1.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-ua77e4421b2e93013ec-1.text: 4) by other methods not prohibited by law.
ekb-ua77e4421b2e93013ec-1.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u22178869e3edb745ea-1.text: The campaign period begins on the day of official publication (promulgation) of the City Duma’s decision to hold a vote to recall the Head of Yekaterinburg and ends at midnight local time at the beginning of the day before polling day. Campaigning is prohibited on polling day and the preceding day.
ekb-u22178869e3edb745ea-1.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-ue3069f4b97b32ba308-1.text: 21. Voting, counting of votes and determination of voting totals are carried out in accordance with the federal law establishing basic guarantees of the electoral rights of citizens of the Russian Federation and the law of Sverdlovsk Oblast adopted in accordance with it.
ekb-ue3069f4b97b32ba308-1.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u74bbc997f96f168a48-1.text: 22. Repealed with effect from 31 October 2022 by Decision of the Yekaterinburg City Duma of 09.08.2022 No. 26/76.
ekb-u74bbc997f96f168a48-1.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u626c7d3f0dae9abe1b-1.text: 23. The Head of Yekaterinburg is deemed recalled if at least half of all voters registered in the municipality have voted for recall.
ekb-u626c7d3f0dae9abe1b-1.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u1f265f5b9395a069c4-1.text: 24. The voting totals for recall of the Head of Yekaterinburg and the decision adopted are subject to official publication (promulgation) within 5 days from adoption of that decision.
ekb-u1f265f5b9395a069c4-1.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u981d9546acfaa0107e-1.text: 25. Repealed with effect from 31 October 2022 by Decision of the Yekaterinburg City Duma of 09.08.2022 No. 26/76.
ekb-u981d9546acfaa0107e-1.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u92173d9f4ef47af2f2-1.text: Article 16. Voting on changing the boundaries or transforming the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”
ekb-u92173d9f4ef47af2f2-1.locator: Article 16. Voting on changing the boundaries or transforming the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”

ekb-uba42f927397c2099b2-1.text: 1. Voting is held to obtain the population’s consent to a change in the municipality’s boundaries or transformation of the municipality, except in cases provided for by the federal law establishing the general principles of the organization of local self-government in the Russian Federation.
ekb-uba42f927397c2099b2-1.locator: Article 16. Voting on changing the boundaries or transforming the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”

ekb-u63a181cc4952893b85-1.text: 2. Voting on those matters may be held throughout or in part of the municipality’s territory in accordance with federal law.
ekb-u63a181cc4952893b85-1.locator: Article 16. Voting on changing the boundaries or transforming the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”

ekb-u7668ada125cffa8930-1.text: 3. Voting on changing the municipality’s boundaries or transforming the municipality is called by the City Duma and held in accordance with the procedure established for local referendums by federal law and a law of Sverdlovsk Oblast.
ekb-u7668ada125cffa8930-1.locator: Article 16. Voting on changing the boundaries or transforming the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”

ekb-udf62dca7fb1c55d3ea-1.text: 4. Voting on those matters is deemed to have taken place if more than half of the residents of the municipality (the relevant part of its territory) who have voting rights participate. The population’s consent to changing the boundaries or transforming the municipality is deemed obtained if more than half of the residents of the municipality (the relevant part of its territory) who participated in the vote have voted in favour.
ekb-udf62dca7fb1c55d3ea-1.locator: Article 16. Voting on changing the boundaries or transforming the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”

ekb-u71326f8cdc611ca865-1.text: 5. The voting totals on changing the municipality’s boundaries or transforming the municipality and the decision adopted are subject to official publication (promulgation).
ekb-u71326f8cdc611ca865-1.locator: Article 16. Voting on changing the boundaries or transforming the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”

ekb-ub3f6bb441d0c685c86-1.locator: Article 16. Voting on changing the boundaries or transforming the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”

ekb-u364352614111a3676a-1.text: 1. In cases provided for by Federal Law of 6 October 2003 No. 131-ФЗ ‘On the General Principles of the Organization of Local Self-Government in the Russian Federation’, a citizens’ assembly may be held in settlements within the municipality (or, in accordance with a law of Sverdlovsk Oblast, in part of a settlement’s territory within the municipality).
ekb-u364352614111a3676a-1.locator: Article 16. Voting on changing the boundaries or transforming the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”

ekb-ueba660f8ed21505370-1.text: 2. A citizens’ assembly has a quorum if more than half of the residents of the settlement (or part of its territory) who have voting rights participate. A decision of the assembly is deemed adopted if more than half of its participants have voted in favour.
ekb-ueba660f8ed21505370-1.locator: Article 16. Voting on changing the boundaries or transforming the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”

ekb-u26d13e105faa44b4f5-1.text: 3. The procedure for organizing and holding a citizens’ assembly is determined by a decision of the City Duma.
ekb-u26d13e105faa44b4f5-1.locator: Article 16. Voting on changing the boundaries or transforming the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”

ekb-uadd185f1170d4cec7c-1.text: 1. A law-making initiative means citizens’ official submission to the municipality’s local self-government bodies of draft municipal legal acts on matters of local significance.

ekb-uea63c3b2297843cdc2-1.text: 2. An initiative group of citizens with voting rights may put forward a law-making initiative in accordance with the procedure established by a decision of the City Duma.

ekb-uda31867f4b7035220c-1.text: The minimum size of a citizens’ initiative group is established by a decision of the City Duma and may not exceed 3 percent of the municipality’s residents with voting rights.

ekb-u0be46bf1ad3f911e0b-1.text: 3. A draft municipal legal act submitted through a citizens’ law-making initiative must be considered by the Head of Yekaterinburg or the City Duma, within whose competence adoption of the act falls, within three months of its submission. If adoption of the submitted draft falls within the City Duma’s competence, it is considered at an open meeting of the City Duma.

ekb-ub069557f049e816970-1.text: Representatives of the citizens’ initiative group must be given an opportunity to present their position during consideration of the submitted draft municipal legal act.

ekb-ub2052ce24423373888-1.text: 4. The reasoned decision adopted following consideration of a draft municipal legal act submitted through a citizens’ law-making initiative must be officially communicated in writing to the citizens’ initiative group that submitted it.

ekb-u6964021148a0a8fbb6-1.text: 1. An initiative project may be submitted to the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg to implement measures of priority importance to residents of the municipality or part of it, addressing matters of local significance or other matters that the municipality’s local self-government bodies have been granted the right to address.

ekb-ude5262f4a1b1c89554-1.text: 2. The initiative to submit an initiative project may be put forward by an initiative group of at least ten citizens who have reached sixteen years of age and reside in the municipality, territorial public self-government bodies, or the headperson of a rural settlement. The minimum size of the initiative group may be reduced by a decision of the City Duma. A decision of the City Duma may also grant other persons carrying out activities in the municipality’s territory the right to initiate a project.

ekb-u777b99c8a0d9f28b81-1.text: 3. An initiative project must meet the requirements established by Federal Law of 6 October 2003 No. 131-ФЗ ‘On the General Principles of the Organization of Local Self-Government in the Russian Federation’.

ekb-ucf4e0475a31b371c78-1.text: 4. The procedure for proposing, submitting, discussing and considering initiative projects and conducting their competitive selection is established by the City Duma.

ekb-u81c73014dbadfe2c71-1.text: 5. Other matters concerning the proposing, submission, discussion and consideration of initiative projects, their competitive selection, and financial and other support for their implementation are regulated in accordance with the requirements established by Federal Law of 6 October 2003 No. 131-ФЗ ‘On the General Principles of the Organization of Local Self-Government in the Russian Federation’.

ekb-u4977a66d698ba4c36d-1.text: 1. The population of the municipality has the right to organize itself at its place of residence in part of the municipality’s territory (an entrance section of an apartment building, an apartment building, a group of residential buildings, a residential microdistrict, settlements and other populated places within the municipality, or other areas where citizens reside) to implement its own initiatives on matters of local significance independently and under its own responsibility.

ekb-ue2283756ad616a3245-1.text: The boundaries of the territory in which territorial public self-government is exercised are established by the City Duma on the proposal of the population residing in that territory.

ekb-u5d5c5a51b0eee50921-1.text: 2. Territorial public self-government is exercised through citizens’ meetings and conferences and through the establishment of territorial public self-government bodies elected at meetings and conferences of citizens residing in the relevant territory.

ekb-ufeda054a2a667d3ed9-1.text: 3. Territorial public self-government may, in accordance with its charter, constitute a legal entity and is subject to state registration in the organizational and legal form of a non-profit organization. Territorial public self-government is deemed established upon registration of its charter.

ekb-u34bc9fb0d091513d2c-1.text: 4. The procedure for registering the charter of territorial public self-government is determined by a decision of the City Duma.

ekb-u57796a536525286cf0-1.text: 5. The procedure for organizing and exercising territorial public self-government and the conditions and procedure for allocating the necessary funds from the municipal budget are determined by decisions of the City Duma.

ekb-ud7de4b8d3f30f7e4da-1.text: Article 18-1. Headperson of a rural settlement

ekb-u36f5842c08f905fd0b-1.text: 1. To organize interaction between the municipality’s local self-government bodies and residents of a rural settlement in addressing matters of local significance, a headperson may be appointed in a rural settlement situated within the municipality.

ekb-uebf2ebbfe19ea05878-1.text: 2. The headperson of a rural settlement is appointed by the City Duma on the nomination of the settlement’s citizens’ assembly. The headperson is appointed from among citizens of the Russian Federation residing in that rural settlement and entitled to vote, or citizens of the Russian Federation who have reached 18 years of age on the date of nomination by the citizens’ assembly and own residential premises situated in that rural settlement.

ekb-uc1ba5a6bb570003829-1.text: 3. The headperson of a rural settlement is not a person holding a state office, a state civil service position, a municipal office other than the municipal office of a City Duma deputy exercising powers on a non-permanent basis, or a municipal service position, and may not have employment relations or other relations directly connected with them with local self-government bodies.

ekb-u3e53d1e8a233561d51-1.text: 4. A person may not be appointed headperson of a rural settlement in the cases established by Federal Law of 6 October 2003 No. 131-ФЗ ‘On the General Principles of the Organization of Local Self-Government in the Russian Federation’.

ekb-uccf3abbf21b232ab4e-1.text: 5. The term of office of the headperson of a rural settlement is two years.

ekb-ua48373a35b1053f031-1.text: The powers of the headperson of a rural settlement terminate early by decision of the City Duma on the proposal of the settlement’s citizens’ assembly, and in the cases established by Federal Law of 6 October 2003 No. 131-ФЗ ‘On the General Principles of the Organization of Local Self-Government in the Russian Federation’.

ekb-u2f5b1607e22c4ca60c-1.text: 6. To perform the tasks assigned to them, the headperson of a rural settlement:

ekb-u5d65136b77b11febc7-1.text: 1) interacts with the municipality’s local self-government bodies, municipal enterprises and institutions, and other organizations on addressing matters of local significance in the rural settlement;

ekb-uc311cdd76b6baf72f2-1.text: 2) interacts with the population, including through participation in citizens’ assemblies, meetings and conferences, and, following those events, submits appeals and proposals, including in the form of draft municipal legal acts, which must be considered by the municipality’s local self-government bodies;

ekb-ucbc888faf5e53acd5f-1.text: 3) informs residents of the rural settlement about the organization and exercise of local self-government and assists in communicating to them other information received from the municipality’s local self-government bodies;

ekb-u3184352ca14bb4b62c-1.text: 4) assists the municipality’s local self-government bodies in organizing and conducting public hearings and public discussions and promulgating their results in the rural settlement;

ekb-ub1b02b119e097a3000-1.text: 5) may initiate submission of an initiative project on matters of priority importance to residents of the rural settlement;

ekb-ude41728d6f06dc0fcd-1.text: 6) exercises other powers and rights provided for by a decision of the City Duma in accordance with a law of Sverdlovsk Oblast.

ekb-uf8d11a56d81db23ef4-1.text: 7. Guarantees for the activities of a rural settlement’s headperson and other matters concerning their status may be established by a decision of the City Duma in accordance with a law of Sverdlovsk Oblast.

ekb-u914cfb7482f865704c-1.text: Article 19. Public hearings and public discussions
ekb-u914cfb7482f865704c-1.locator: Article 19. Public hearings and public discussions

ekb-u7f0c82af5b88e27439-1.text: 1. The Head of Yekaterinburg and the City Duma may hold public hearings to discuss draft municipal legal acts on matters of local significance with the participation of residents of the municipality.
ekb-u7f0c82af5b88e27439-1.locator: Article 19. Public hearings and public discussions

ekb-u3e8ec8f659139dcfb2-1.text: 2. Public hearings are held on the initiative of the population, the City Duma or the Head of Yekaterinburg.
ekb-u3e8ec8f659139dcfb2-1.locator: Article 19. Public hearings and public discussions

ekb-udcd6030b51bf262833-1.text: Public hearings held on the initiative of the population or the City Duma are called by the City Duma; those held on the initiative of the Head of Yekaterinburg are called by the Head of Yekaterinburg.
ekb-udcd6030b51bf262833-1.locator: Article 19. Public hearings and public discussions

ekb-ud079f33e176630aff2-1.text: 3. The following must be submitted to public hearings:
ekb-ud079f33e176630aff2-1.locator: Article 19. Public hearings and public discussions

ekb-u0d9536b6bafddc1368-1.text: 1) the draft Charter of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg” and a draft decision of the City Duma amending or supplementing that Charter, except where amendments exactly reproduce provisions of the Constitution of the Russian Federation, federal laws, or the Charter or laws of Sverdlovsk Oblast in order to bring the Charter of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg” into conformity with those regulatory legal acts;
ekb-u0d9536b6bafddc1368-1.locator: Article 19. Public hearings and public discussions

ekb-u46d5e7d45abb30e5e5-1.text: 2) the draft municipal budget and the report on its execution;
ekb-u46d5e7d45abb30e5e5-1.locator: Article 19. Public hearings and public discussions

ekb-ub1ce8530d86869f4d1-1.text: 3) the draft socioeconomic development strategy of the municipality;
ekb-ub1ce8530d86869f4d1-1.locator: Article 19. Public hearings and public discussions

ekb-uc1289f8b2344b7f0c2-1.text: 4) matters concerning transformation of the municipality, except where Article 13 of Federal Law of 6 October 2003 No. 131-ФЗ ‘On the General Principles of the Organization of Local Self-Government in the Russian Federation’ requires the population’s consent to the transformation to be obtained through a vote;
ekb-uc1289f8b2344b7f0c2-1.locator: Article 19. Public hearings and public discussions

ekb-u1f7966dccf2c480e77-1.text: 5) repealed by Decision of the Yekaterinburg City Duma of 10.04.2018 No. 9/78.
ekb-u1f7966dccf2c480e77-1.locator: Article 19. Public hearings and public discussions

ekb-u00fb880ac2eb684803-1.text: 4. The procedure for organizing and holding public hearings is determined by a decision of the City Duma.
ekb-u00fb880ac2eb684803-1.locator: Article 19. Public hearings and public discussions

ekb-u8229f675ea76647f0c-1.text: 5. The results of public hearings, including the reasoned justification for decisions adopted, are subject to publication (promulgation).
ekb-u8229f675ea76647f0c-1.locator: Article 19. Public hearings and public discussions

ekb-ucec314d9ba130387df-1.text: 6. Public hearings or public discussions are held, in accordance with urban planning legislation, on draft master plans; draft land use and development rules; draft territorial planning and land subdivision plans; draft territorial improvement rules; drafts amending any of those approved documents; draft decisions granting permission for a conditionally permitted use of a land plot or capital construction facility; draft decisions granting permission to depart from the limiting parameters of permitted construction or reconstruction of capital construction facilities; and changes from one permitted use of land plots or capital construction facilities to another where no approved land use and development rules exist.
ekb-ucec314d9ba130387df-1.locator: Article 19. Public hearings and public discussions

ekb-u7edee6a17df3698012-1.text: 1. Citizens’ meetings may be held to discuss matters of local significance, inform the population of the municipality about the activities of local self-government bodies and officials, discuss the submission and consideration of initiative projects, and exercise territorial public self-government in part of the municipality’s territory.

ekb-uca51dbb540a8fd1788-1.text: 2. Citizens’ meetings are held on the basis of and in accordance with Federal Law of 6 October 2003 No. 131-ФЗ ‘On the General Principles of the Organization of Local Self-Government in the Russian Federation’ and this Charter.

ekb-u54ed1122ee0bcd415b-1.text: 3. A citizens’ meeting is held on the initiative of the municipality’s population, the City Duma or the Head of Yekaterinburg, and in cases provided for by the charter of territorial public self-government.

ekb-u0daac0a621c08c0abb-1.text: 4. A citizens’ meeting held on the initiative of the City Duma or the Head of Yekaterinburg is called, respectively, by the City Duma or the Head of Yekaterinburg in accordance with the procedure established by the City Duma.

ekb-u31c5fa3d55d70e3410-1.text: A citizens’ meeting held on the initiative of the municipality’s population is called by the City Duma in accordance with the procedure established by this Charter.

ekb-uef3d47355b5b4a9169-1.text: The procedure for calling and holding a citizens’ meeting to exercise territorial public self-government is determined by the charter of territorial public self-government.

ekb-ucd9285805e92d365e3-1.text: The procedure for calling and holding a citizens’ meeting to consider and discuss the submission of initiative projects is determined by a decision of the City Duma. Residents of the relevant territory who have reached sixteen years of age may participate in a citizens’ meeting on the submission and consideration of initiative projects.

ekb-u478b7c50834899e8cf-1.text: 5. When citizens’ meetings are held on the initiative of the municipality’s population, they are organized by an initiative group of at least ten citizens residing in the relevant territory.

ekb-uaf699e65f6f6a8c460-1.text: The citizens’ initiative group decides to hold a citizens’ meeting and submits an appeal to the City Duma proposing that the meeting be called, which must state:

ekb-u0363dbfbfa127072a5-1.text: the place and time of the meeting;

ekb-u7a48f7cd009461b677-1.text: the matters to be submitted for discussion at the citizens’ meeting;

ekb-u2002435acfd9a75b41-1.text: the reasons why those matters need to be discussed at the meeting;

ekb-u48162b97c886986ae9-1.text: the territory within which the citizens’ meeting is proposed to be held;

ekb-ua6a7c66a6f6836d8aa-1.text: the list of citizens’ initiative group members, stating each member’s surname, given name, patronymic, place of residence and contact telephone numbers.

ekb-uafa9e91ddcb870d372-1.text: The appeal must be signed by all members of the initiative group.

ekb-ue0c2637727e6cd1f89-1.text: 6. Within no more than one month after receiving the initiative group’s appeal, the City Duma decides to call the citizens’ meeting or to refuse to call it, and informs the initiative group of its decision in writing.

ekb-u96ec79741cb416019b-1.text: 7. A citizens’ meeting may be refused only where the initiative group has breached point 5 of this Article.

ekb-uabdf3369846732958e-1.text: 8. The City Duma’s decision calling a citizens’ meeting on the initiative of the municipality’s population specifies the place and time of the meeting and the matters to be discussed.

ekb-u5908e79589d1299aa7-1.text: 9. The City Duma’s decision or the Head of Yekaterinburg’s resolution calling a citizens’ meeting on the initiative of those local self-government bodies specifies the place and time of the meeting, the matters to be discussed, and the local self-government officials responsible for preparing the meeting.

ekb-u26e6446f88ad694e1c-1.text: The Head of Yekaterinburg approves plans of organizational measures for convening citizens’ meetings and prepares the documents and materials necessary for holding them.

ekb-ua94ccb94b64cf93cc8-1.text: 10. The decision to hold a citizens’ meeting and the documents and materials submitted to it are communicated to the municipality’s population through the mass media or by other means in advance, but no later than three days before the meeting.

ekb-u0ae86e028304c707c1-1.text: 11. The Head of Yekaterinburg and other local self-government officials of the municipality assist citizens in obtaining premises for a citizens’ meeting within their respective powers.

ekb-ue748dabd11b0ad6a09-1.text: 12. The powers of a citizens’ meeting include the right to consider and decide any matters significant to its territory, except matters within the powers of the municipality’s local self-government bodies, officials of state authorities and local self-government bodies, organizations of various forms of ownership, or public associations.

ekb-u7299ac2509f153e0a5-1.text: 13. Decisions adopted at a citizens’ meeting apply only to residents of the relevant territories, are advisory and are implemented by residents voluntarily.

ekb-u03536a90d57a75fc56-1.text: 14. The procedure for holding a citizens’ meeting is determined by a decision of the City Duma and the charter of territorial public self-government, in accordance with Federal Law of 6 October 2003 No. 131-ФЗ ‘On the General Principles of the Organization of Local Self-Government in the Russian Federation’ and this Charter.

ekb-u879fd45bd13712591f-1.text: 15. Appeals adopted by a citizens’ meeting must be considered by the local self-government bodies and officials competent to resolve the matters raised in them, with a written response being sent.

ekb-u98685baf39ccf3cf9f-1.text: 16. The outcomes of a citizens’ meeting are subject to official publication (promulgation).

ekb-u78f875b54778172952-1.text: 1. In cases provided for by decisions of the City Duma or the charter of territorial public self-government, the powers of a citizens’ meeting may be exercised by a citizens’ conference (meeting of delegates).

ekb-ue29d828aba0d877a84-1.text: 2. The procedure for calling and holding a citizens’ conference (meeting of delegates) and electing its delegates is determined by decisions of the City Duma and the charter of territorial public self-government.

ekb-ucbf6d01cafdc30bcf4-1.text: 3. The outcomes of a citizens’ conference (meeting of delegates) are subject to official publication (promulgation).

ekb-uca13f4c10fd0f0b9df-1.text: 1. A citizens’ survey is conducted throughout or in part of the municipality’s territory to ascertain the population’s opinion and take it into account in decisions by the City Duma, the Head of Yekaterinburg and state authorities.

ekb-u8378909aeee62fc4f6-1.text: 2. Residents of the municipality who have voting rights may participate in a citizens’ survey.

ekb-u9c1ede66ede8db5f86-1.text: Residents of the municipality or the part of it in which an initiative project is proposed to be implemented who have reached sixteen years of age may participate in a citizens’ survey to ascertain opinions on support for that project.

ekb-u3cd974748ef5dfd738-1.text: 3. The procedure for calling and conducting a citizens’ survey is determined by a decision of the City Duma in accordance with a law of Sverdlovsk Oblast.

ekb-u0e2811299d8f960cb9-1.text: 4. The decision to call a citizens’ survey is adopted by the City Duma.

ekb-ufc32374e28edc5e19f-1.text: 5. Residents of the municipality must be informed of a citizens’ survey at least 10 days before it is conducted.

ekb-u571e7db4838fc55e2c-1.text: 6. Measures connected with preparing and conducting a citizens’ survey are financed in accordance with federal legislation.

ekb-u2c8566126d103e2755-1.text: Article 23. Citizens’ appeals to local self-government bodies of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”
ekb-u2c8566126d103e2755-1.locator: Article 23. Citizens’ appeals to local self-government bodies of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”

ekb-ud3cb27005256eabae3-1.text: 1. Citizens have the right to submit individual and collective appeals to local self-government bodies
ekb-ud3cb27005256eabae3-1.locator: Article 23. Citizens’ appeals to local self-government bodies of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”

ekb-u055063719dc04339d0-1.text: 2. Citizens’ appeals are considered in accordance with the procedure and time limits established by Federal Law of 2 May 2006 No. 59-ФЗ ‘On the Procedure for Considering Appeals from Citizens of the Russian Federation’.
ekb-u055063719dc04339d0-1.locator: Article 23. Citizens’ appeals to local self-government bodies of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”

ekb-u24d43123ad40f5d8e5-1.text: 3. Local self-government officials bear the liability established by legislation for breaches of the procedure or time limits for considering citizens’ appeals.
ekb-u24d43123ad40f5d8e5-1.locator: Article 23. Citizens’ appeals to local self-government bodies of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”

ekb-u2e60b1d45e0d5f5442-1.text: Article 23-1. Civic Chamber of the municipality
ekb-u2e60b1d45e0d5f5442-1.locator: Article 23. Citizens’ appeals to local self-government bodies of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”

ekb-uc57b70737ab8380b95-1.text: 1. The Civic Chamber of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg” (hereinafter referred to as the Civic Chamber) discusses a broad range of socially significant issues and submits proposals for resolving them to local self-government bodies of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”.
ekb-uc57b70737ab8380b95-1.locator: Article 23. Citizens’ appeals to local self-government bodies of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”

ekb-ub67f566c933b7d57d5-1.text: 2. The Civic Chamber operates on a non-permanent basis and is not a local self-government body.
ekb-ub67f566c933b7d57d5-1.locator: Article 23. Citizens’ appeals to local self-government bodies of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”

ekb-udfc6d354633861af3e-1.text: Decisions of the Civic Chamber are advisory.
ekb-udfc6d354633861af3e-1.locator: Article 23. Citizens’ appeals to local self-government bodies of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”

ekb-u42055c0a0f15d9760f-1.text: 3. The Civic Chamber is formed from residents of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg” who have their permanent residence in that municipality and have reached eighteen years of age.
ekb-u42055c0a0f15d9760f-1.locator: Article 23. Citizens’ appeals to local self-government bodies of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”

ekb-uc7cfd6c07e019a9ca0-1.text: 4. Members of the Civic Chamber exercise their powers without release from their principal work and without remuneration.
ekb-uc7cfd6c07e019a9ca0-1.locator: Article 23. Citizens’ appeals to local self-government bodies of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”

ekb-u60064f123dbe130282-1.text: 5. The formation procedure, number of members, status and operating procedures of the Civic Chamber are governed by regulations approved by the City Duma.
ekb-u60064f123dbe130282-1.locator: Article 23. Citizens’ appeals to local self-government bodies of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”

ekb-ud91a6ad5a5562dab1e-1.text: Chapter IV. BODIES AND OFFICIALS OF LOCAL SELF-GOVERNMENT
ekb-ud91a6ad5a5562dab1e-1.locator: Chapter IV. BODIES AND OFFICIALS OF LOCAL SELF-GOVERNMENT

ekb-u575edf2283e1b5d671-1.locator: Chapter IV. BODIES AND OFFICIALS OF LOCAL SELF-GOVERNMENT

ekb-u75eb742827ce3f44ee-1.text: Article 24. Structure of local self-government bodies
ekb-u75eb742827ce3f44ee-1.locator: Article 24. Structure of local self-government bodies
