ekb-ud7d14b8c54548d7b6e-1.text: 1. The structure of local self-government bodies comprises the City Duma, the Head of Yekaterinburg, the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg and the Chamber of Accounts.
ekb-ud7d14b8c54548d7b6e-1.locator: Article 24. Structure of local self-government bodies

ekb-u3d60aab48c0a81edaf-1.text: 2. The formation procedure, powers, term of office, accountability and subjection to oversight of local self-government bodies, and other matters concerning their organization and activities, are determined by this Charter.
ekb-u3d60aab48c0a81edaf-1.locator: Article 24. Structure of local self-government bodies

ekb-udbf8e3f1b438704dcc-1.text: 3. The municipality’s local self-government bodies do not form part of the system of state authorities.
ekb-udbf8e3f1b438704dcc-1.locator: Article 24. Structure of local self-government bodies

ekb-ua46312d738e2f39397-1.text: 4. The structure of the municipality’s local self-government bodies may be changed only by amending and supplementing this Charter.
ekb-ua46312d738e2f39397-1.locator: Article 24. Structure of local self-government bodies

ekb-u4740800362c8e609f2-1.text: 5. A City Duma decision changing the structure of local self-government bodies enters into force no earlier than the expiry of the term of the City Duma that adopted it, except in cases provided for by Federal Law of 6 October 2003 No. 131-ФЗ ‘On the General Principles of the Organization of Local Self-Government in the Russian Federation’.
ekb-u4740800362c8e609f2-1.locator: Article 24. Structure of local self-government bodies

ekb-ubaad3481529c522459-1.text: 6. The activities of local self-government bodies are financed exclusively from the municipal budget’s own revenue.
ekb-ubaad3481529c522459-1.locator: Article 24. Structure of local self-government bodies

ekb-uc71e78a56b709fda54-1.text: 7. Local self-government bodies act in accordance with their own powers to address matters of local significance established by federal and oblast legislation and this Charter. They may not take up matters assigned to the jurisdiction of other local self-government bodies.
ekb-uc71e78a56b709fda54-1.locator: Article 24. Structure of local self-government bodies

ekb-u01362459805687d32a-1.text: 1. The City Duma is the representative body of the municipality, vested with its own powers to address matters of local significance. The term of the City Duma is 5 years.

ekb-ueb5f77912e97fb4625-1.text: 2-1. 25 City Duma deputies are elected in single-member constituencies formed within the municipality’s territory, and 10 deputies are elected in a single constituency covering the municipality’s entire territory, in proportion to the number of votes received by each candidate list nominated by electoral associations.

ekb-uebe4aa8d7f3fe54e14-1.text: 3. City Duma deputies are elected for 5 years in municipal elections on the basis of universal, equal and direct suffrage by secret ballot, in accordance with federal and oblast electoral legislation and this Charter.

ekb-u8e2c2d446b167f39e2-1.text: 4. The City Duma may exercise its powers after at least two thirds of the prescribed number of deputies have been elected.

ekb-u1d4775e3d9e56791a1-1.text: 5. Meetings are the principal organizational form of the City Duma’s activities. Its first meeting is held no later than two weeks after at least two thirds of the prescribed number of deputies have been elected. A City Duma meeting cannot have a quorum if fewer than fifty percent of the elected deputies are present.

ekb-u5f3057d1126ce48c26-1.text: Matters within the City Duma’s jurisdiction are decided at its meetings. The frequency of meetings and the procedure for convening and holding them are established by the City Duma’s Rules of Procedure.

ekb-u63e51f63afc84dde45-1.text: 6. Within its powers, the City Duma adopts decisions establishing rules binding throughout the municipality’s territory and decisions concerning the organization of the City Duma’s activities.

ekb-uf6dc15cb933f38580d-1.text: 7. The City Duma adopts Rules of Procedure governing the organization of its activities and the procedure for adopting decisions.

ekb-uc2d02952a8edf4ac8a-1.text: 8. The City Duma has the rights of a legal entity.

ekb-u80f898240fdc7e2ae8-1.text: 9. Expenditure to support the City Duma’s activities is provided for as a separate line in the municipal budget in accordance with the budget expenditure classification of the Russian Federation.

ekb-uf7519ad137c66baba8-1.text: Article 26. Powers of the City Duma
ekb-uf7519ad137c66baba8-1.locator: Article 26. Powers of the City Duma

ekb-u64078b8686258e8b53-1.text: 1. The City Duma’s exclusive powers include:
ekb-u64078b8686258e8b53-1.locator: Article 26. Powers of the City Duma

ekb-ubf5d6bb0a43ecfc72c-1.text: 1) adopting the Charter of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg” and amending and supplementing it;
ekb-ubf5d6bb0a43ecfc72c-1.locator: Article 26. Powers of the City Duma

ekb-u94ea6a8c71c4020c2f-1.text: 1-1) adopting a decision to dismiss the Head of Yekaterinburg from office;
ekb-u94ea6a8c71c4020c2f-1.locator: Article 26. Powers of the City Duma

ekb-u85aa3ff6200fa2676b-1.text: 2) approving the municipal budget and the report on its execution on the proposal of the Head of Yekaterinburg;
ekb-u85aa3ff6200fa2676b-1.locator: Article 26. Powers of the City Duma

ekb-u6835aee079a0eeb597-1.text: 3) introducing, amending and abolishing local taxes and levies on the proposal of the Head of Yekaterinburg, and establishing relief from those taxes and levies;
ekb-u6835aee079a0eeb597-1.locator: Article 26. Powers of the City Duma

ekb-u15c0c74695700f23ce-1.text: 4) approving the municipality’s socioeconomic development strategy;
ekb-u15c0c74695700f23ce-1.locator: Article 26. Powers of the City Duma

ekb-u6b4a95569955048859-1.text: 4-1) approving rules for improvement of the municipality’s territory;
ekb-u6b4a95569955048859-1.locator: Article 26. Powers of the City Duma

ekb-u40dddaa4917ad43b15-1.text: 5) determining the procedure for managing and disposing of municipally owned property on the proposal of the Head of Yekaterinburg;
ekb-u40dddaa4917ad43b15-1.locator: Article 26. Powers of the City Duma

ekb-u26ddd2aa71eeb0a928-1.text: 6) determining, on the proposal of the Head of Yekaterinburg, the procedure for adopting decisions to establish, reorganize or liquidate municipal enterprises and to set tariffs for municipal enterprises’ and institutions’ services and the performance of work, except in cases provided for by federal laws;
ekb-u26ddd2aa71eeb0a928-1.locator: Article 26. Powers of the City Duma

ekb-u5f6121235a60da74a9-1.text: 7) determining the procedure for the municipality’s participation in intermunicipal cooperation organizations;
ekb-u5f6121235a60da74a9-1.locator: Article 26. Powers of the City Duma

ekb-u3ccf18be70cbcc0e8e-1.text: 8) determining the procedure for providing material, technical and organizational support for the activities of the municipality’s local self-government bodies;
ekb-u3ccf18be70cbcc0e8e-1.locator: Article 26. Powers of the City Duma

ekb-u51a5c660a18ffd6cd0-1.text: 9) overseeing the exercise by local self-government bodies and officials of powers to address matters of local significance.
ekb-u51a5c660a18ffd6cd0-1.locator: Article 26. Powers of the City Duma

ekb-uf7bc62fe54ae4e5f19-1.text: 2. The City Duma’s jurisdiction also includes:
ekb-uf7bc62fe54ae4e5f19-1.locator: Article 26. Powers of the City Duma

ekb-u7a6b602fb1cf6f9821-1.text: 1) approving the structure of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg on the proposal of the Head of Yekaterinburg;
ekb-u7a6b602fb1cf6f9821-1.locator: Article 26. Powers of the City Duma

ekb-ua6d2c50388569d986e-1.text: 2) repealed by Decision of the Yekaterinburg City Duma of 08.04.2014 No. 8/14;
ekb-ua6d2c50388569d986e-1.locator: Article 26. Powers of the City Duma

ekb-ud22b41f8966a24ff21-1.text: 3) repealed with effect from 31 October 2022 by Decision of the Yekaterinburg City Duma of 09.08.2022 No. 26/76;
ekb-ud22b41f8966a24ff21-1.locator: Article 26. Powers of the City Duma

ekb-u1b3b2448d2aae98a56-1.text: 4) submitting initiatives to state authorities of Sverdlovsk Oblast to change the boundaries or transform the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”;
ekb-u1b3b2448d2aae98a56-1.locator: Article 26. Powers of the City Duma

ekb-u0c7e57342edfad2f46-1.text: 5) calling municipal elections and local referendums;
ekb-u0c7e57342edfad2f46-1.locator: Article 26. Powers of the City Duma

ekb-u5623f559f18756b379-1.text: 6) establishing the procedure for preparing, considering and approving the draft municipal budget and for executing and overseeing execution of the municipal budget; deciding the period for which the draft municipal budget is prepared and approved — one year (the next financial year) or three years (the next financial year and the planning period); and establishing the procedure for approving the report on execution of the municipal budget for the preceding financial year;
ekb-u5623f559f18756b379-1.locator: Article 26. Powers of the City Duma

ekb-u378b5734161854e74e-1.text: 7) repealed by Decision of the Yekaterinburg City Duma of 08.04.2014 No. 8/14;
ekb-u378b5734161854e74e-1.locator: Article 26. Powers of the City Duma

ekb-u2b75eb7797d8259aff-1.text: 8) establishing the procedure for providing municipal guarantees and for municipal loans (borrowing);
ekb-u2b75eb7797d8259aff-1.locator: Article 26. Powers of the City Duma

ekb-u98f52c6536e7ab1b03-1.text: 9) adopting regulatory legal acts on other financial and budgetary matters in accordance with legislation;
ekb-u98f52c6536e7ab1b03-1.locator: Article 26. Powers of the City Duma

ekb-u1da985eace4e50e80a-1.text: 9-1) hearing annual reports by the Head of Yekaterinburg on the results of the Head’s activities and those of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg, including the resolution of matters raised by the City Duma;
ekb-u1da985eace4e50e80a-1.locator: Article 26. Powers of the City Duma

ekb-u2689060d33867a3992-1.text: 10) other matters in accordance with federal laws, laws of Sverdlovsk Oblast and this Charter.
ekb-u2689060d33867a3992-1.locator: Article 26. Powers of the City Duma

ekb-u2b295a3e6993df984e-1.text: Article 27. Structure of the City Duma
ekb-u2b295a3e6993df984e-1.locator: Article 27. Structure of the City Duma

ekb-uf7bd1f961c37a72b15-1.text: 1. The City Duma independently determines its structure in accordance with this Charter.
ekb-uf7bd1f961c37a72b15-1.locator: Article 27. Structure of the City Duma

ekb-ua82a62ab04f5d118ee-1.text: 2. The activities of the City Duma are organized by the Chair of the City Duma, elected from among the deputies according to the procedure determined by the City Duma.
ekb-ua82a62ab04f5d118ee-1.locator: Article 27. Structure of the City Duma

ekb-ub078e5e26a4c6f3aa7-1.text: 3. The First Deputy Chair of the City Duma and the Deputy Chair of the City Duma (hereinafter also referred to as the Deputy Chairs of the City Duma) are elected from among the deputies of the City Duma. The procedure for electing the Deputy Chairs of the City Duma is determined by the Rules of Procedure of the City Duma.
ekb-ub078e5e26a4c6f3aa7-1.locator: Article 27. Structure of the City Duma

ekb-ubfa37b6933bec26631-1.text: 4. The Chair of the City Duma and the Deputy Chairs of the City Duma are local self-government officials. The Chair of the City Duma and the First Deputy Chair of the City Duma exercise their powers on a full-time basis.
ekb-ubfa37b6933bec26631-1.locator: Article 27. Structure of the City Duma

ekb-u395668ab9e4e06c386-1.text: 5. The City Duma establishes standing and temporary commissions. The procedure for their formation and the organization of their work are determined by the Rules of Procedure of the City Duma and by regulations on the commissions approved by the City Duma.
ekb-u395668ab9e4e06c386-1.locator: Article 27. Structure of the City Duma

ekb-u88e8b719667e425ea2-1.text: 6. Deputies of the City Duma may establish deputy groups. The procedure for establishing deputy groups and for their activities is determined by the Rules of Procedure of the City Duma and regulations on deputy groups.
ekb-u88e8b719667e425ea2-1.locator: Article 27. Structure of the City Duma

ekb-u0bf935cefb802a657d-1.text: Deputies of the City Duma elected as part of lists of candidates nominated by political parties (their regional branches or other structural subdivisions) belong to deputy associations (factions), except in cases provided for by the federal law establishing the general principles of the organization of local self-government in the Russian Federation.
ekb-u0bf935cefb802a657d-1.locator: Article 27. Structure of the City Duma

ekb-ua3ecbe3db73ca879a8-1.text: 7. The staff of the City Duma is formed to provide organizational, information, legal and logistical support for the activities of deputies and standing and temporary commissions.
ekb-ua3ecbe3db73ca879a8-1.locator: Article 27. Structure of the City Duma

ekb-u17338ef48fccac6d13-1.text: Article 27-1. Powers of the Chair of the City Duma
ekb-u17338ef48fccac6d13-1.locator: Article 27. Structure of the City Duma

ekb-ud34f28cedc9a2accde-1.text: 1. The Chair of the City Duma exercises the following powers:
ekb-ud34f28cedc9a2accde-1.locator: Article 27. Structure of the City Duma

ekb-ub646a960d0f79177d3-1.text: 1) represents the City Duma in relations with the population of the municipality, state authorities, local self-government bodies and officials, and organizations irrespective of their form of ownership, and in conducting international relations;
ekb-ub646a960d0f79177d3-1.locator: Article 27. Structure of the City Duma

ekb-u225c183ac56e2f6527-1.text: 2) organizes the reception of citizens and organizations at the City Duma;
ekb-u225c183ac56e2f6527-1.locator: Article 27. Structure of the City Duma

ekb-ueb2f0c4f12b879f830-1.text: 3) informs the population of the municipality about the activities of the City Duma;
ekb-ueb2f0c4f12b879f830-1.locator: Article 27. Structure of the City Duma

ekb-u6e190ffbe9c455003f-1.text: 4) ensures that public opinion is taken into account when the City Duma adopts decisions;
ekb-u6e190ffbe9c455003f-1.locator: Article 27. Structure of the City Duma

ekb-ua3a5304734080ad0f4-1.text: 5) ensures interaction between the City Duma and other local self-government bodies of the municipality;
ekb-ua3a5304734080ad0f4-1.locator: Article 27. Structure of the City Duma

ekb-u4577367bcc8931621a-1.text: 6) concludes contracts and agreements on behalf of the City Duma;
ekb-u4577367bcc8931621a-1.locator: Article 27. Structure of the City Duma

ekb-u1ab9723f41c3b95901-1.text: 7) acts on behalf of the City Duma without a power of attorney;
ekb-u1ab9723f41c3b95901-1.locator: Article 27. Structure of the City Duma

ekb-u537ab306810e7752fe-1.text: 8) organizes the work of the City Duma, coordinates the activities of its standing and temporary commissions, and issues instructions on matters within their purview;
ekb-u537ab306810e7752fe-1.locator: Article 27. Structure of the City Duma

ekb-ub91aca346316938ffa-1.text: 9) convenes ordinary and extraordinary meetings of the City Duma and informs deputies and the public of their time and place and the draft agenda;
ekb-ub91aca346316938ffa-1.locator: Article 27. Structure of the City Duma

ekb-u293670ac168bc6688f-1.text: 10) prepares meetings of the City Duma and chairs its meetings;
ekb-u293670ac168bc6688f-1.locator: Article 27. Structure of the City Duma

ekb-u94b46abdc90a45c89f-1.text: 11) issues resolutions and executive orders on the organization of the activities of the City Duma and its staff, and signs decisions of the City Duma and minutes of its meetings;
ekb-u94b46abdc90a45c89f-1.locator: Article 27. Structure of the City Duma

ekb-u54fb842f97c5ed5ea0-1.text: 12) opens and closes the City Duma’s ledger accounts and administers its funds in accordance with the approved expenditure estimate;
ekb-u54fb842f97c5ed5ea0-1.locator: Article 27. Structure of the City Duma

ekb-uc5db0d51b4dbbbfbdf-1.locator: Article 27. Structure of the City Duma

ekb-u19fa2a19683406ac5a-1.text: 14) files statements of claim, other applications and complaints with courts and takes measures to safeguard the interests of the City Duma in court;
ekb-u19fa2a19683406ac5a-1.locator: Article 27. Structure of the City Duma

ekb-u842636c6c5a531bab4-1.text: 15) organizes professional education and additional professional education for deputies of the City Duma, as well as professional education and additional professional education for municipal servants holding municipal-service posts in the City Duma;
ekb-u842636c6c5a531bab4-1.locator: Article 27. Structure of the City Duma

ekb-u5c7e95f91e70624354-1.text: 16) exercises overall supervision of the work of the staff of the City Duma;
ekb-u5c7e95f91e70624354-1.locator: Article 27. Structure of the City Duma

ekb-u5d7f413fa52cd95564-1.text: 17) exercises the powers of the representative of the appointing authority (employer);
ekb-u5d7f413fa52cd95564-1.locator: Article 27. Structure of the City Duma

ekb-ufed4990b89fc40d7e7-1.text: 18) exercises other powers provided for by legislation and decisions of the City Duma.
ekb-ufed4990b89fc40d7e7-1.locator: Article 27. Structure of the City Duma

ekb-u9558fe19d8b697a576-1.text: 2. In the absence of the Chair of the City Duma, the powers provided for by this Article of the Charter are exercised, on the Chair’s executive order, by the First Deputy Chair of the City Duma.
ekb-u9558fe19d8b697a576-1.locator: Article 27. Structure of the City Duma

ekb-u7a2acf71a410668c21-1.text: 3. The powers of the Deputy Chairs of the City Duma are determined by the Rules of Procedure of the City Duma and decisions of the City Duma.
ekb-u7a2acf71a410668c21-1.locator: Article 27. Structure of the City Duma

ekb-u637d168823bdd115eb-1.text: Article 28. Repealed as of 23 November 2010. — Decision of the Yekaterinburg City Duma of 12.10.2010 No. 62/29.
ekb-u637d168823bdd115eb-1.locator: Article 28. Repealed as of 23 November 2010. — Decision of the Yekaterinburg City Duma of 12.10.2010 No. 62/29.

ekb-uf099ef18ec3ad0e05a-1.text: Article 29. Deputy of the City Duma
ekb-uf099ef18ec3ad0e05a-1.locator: Article 29. Deputy of the City Duma

ekb-u88e13c1f43e757d377-1.text: 1. A citizen of the Russian Federation who has electoral rights and has reached the age of 18 may be elected a deputy of the City Duma.
ekb-u88e13c1f43e757d377-1.locator: Article 29. Deputy of the City Duma

ekb-ub1658ab18376e0bad4-1.text: 2. A deputy’s powers commence on the day of election and cease on the day the City Duma of the new convocation begins its work, except in cases of early termination of a City Duma deputy’s powers provided for by federal legislation and this Charter.
ekb-ub1658ab18376e0bad4-1.locator: Article 29. Deputy of the City Duma

ekb-u3e11de219d0b76499c-1.text: 3. Deputies of the City Duma generally exercise their powers on a non-full-time basis. The number of City Duma deputies working on a full-time basis is established by the City Duma in accordance with federal legislation.
ekb-u3e11de219d0b76499c-1.locator: Article 29. Deputy of the City Duma

ekb-u616c6ae53519282251-1.text: 4. A deputy of the City Duma carries out their activities in all forms not prohibited by the Constitution of the Russian Federation, federal and oblast legislation or this Charter.
ekb-u616c6ae53519282251-1.locator: Article 29. Deputy of the City Duma

ekb-ud4d93628945e6fa931-1.text: 5. The status of a deputy of the City Duma is determined by federal law and the law of Sverdlovsk Oblast.
ekb-ud4d93628945e6fa931-1.locator: Article 29. Deputy of the City Duma

ekb-u6422bb7f84092e077c-1.text: 6. Guarantees for the exercise of the powers of a deputy of the City Duma are established by this Charter in accordance with federal laws and the laws of Sverdlovsk Oblast.
ekb-u6422bb7f84092e077c-1.locator: Article 29. Deputy of the City Duma

ekb-ub8f060d7901061198c-1.text: 1. A deputy of the City Duma is provided with conditions for the unimpeded exercise of their powers.

ekb-ua06351a0157edc3cf4-1.text: 2. A deputy of the City Duma participates in resolving all matters within the competence of the City Duma.

ekb-u0c502dd1440a4d34fc-1.text: 3. The forms of a City Duma deputy’s activities are:

ekb-uc41fe52dfa597b186b-1.text: 2) participation in meetings of the City Duma;

ekb-uee6882bca046f72ea8-1.text: 3) participation in the work of commissions of the City Duma;

ekb-ud3ff1d49a54142858d-1.text: 4) performance of assignments from the City Duma;

ekb-u143e72c2b78ed16c88-1.text: 7) participation in the work of deputy associations, deputy groups and factions in the City Duma;

ekb-u5f376660fa0975aef6-1.text: 8) addressing questions to officials of local self-government bodies.

ekb-ud0cc0b045760660962-1.text: Deputies’ activities may also take other forms provided for by the Constitution of the Russian Federation, federal laws, the Charter of Sverdlovsk Oblast, the laws of Sverdlovsk Oblast, the Charter of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg” and the Rules of Procedure of the City Duma.

ekb-uac1daee7164bbdde22-1.text: 4. A deputy of the City Duma is provided with logistical and organizational resources.

ekb-u04eea50359a455d100-1.text: Article 31. Basic rights of a deputy of the City Duma
ekb-u04eea50359a455d100-1.locator: Article 31. Basic rights of a deputy of the City Duma

ekb-u3cf637b22a538778fe-1.text: 1. A deputy of the City Duma interacts with state authorities of Sverdlovsk Oblast and local self-government bodies located within the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”.
ekb-u3cf637b22a538778fe-1.locator: Article 31. Basic rights of a deputy of the City Duma

ekb-ud4077f53efd33fbfe0-1.text: A deputy of the City Duma has the right to visit local self-government bodies and municipal enterprises and institutions without hindrance when resolving matters within the competence of the City Duma.
ekb-ud4077f53efd33fbfe0-1.locator: Article 31. Basic rights of a deputy of the City Duma

ekb-u3be65948979eb112e4-1.text: On matters concerning their activities as a deputy, a deputy of the City Duma enjoys the right to be received without waiting in turn by the heads and officials of local self-government bodies and municipal enterprises and institutions.
ekb-u3be65948979eb112e4-1.locator: Article 31. Basic rights of a deputy of the City Duma

ekb-u8d7e62a8da8bd2855f-1.text: 2. A deputy of the City Duma has the right of rule-making initiative in accordance with this Charter.
ekb-u8d7e62a8da8bd2855f-1.locator: Article 31. Basic rights of a deputy of the City Duma

ekb-u9a89de7fe9875506ff-1.text: 3. A deputy of the City Duma has the right to express their opinion and has the right to vote on all matters considered by the City Duma and by any commission of which the deputy is a member.
ekb-u9a89de7fe9875506ff-1.locator: Article 31. Basic rights of a deputy of the City Duma

ekb-u24c8f377d8e2d02a44-1.text: A deputy of the City Duma participates personally in meetings of the City Duma and its commissions.
ekb-u24c8f377d8e2d02a44-1.locator: Article 31. Basic rights of a deputy of the City Duma

ekb-ubda044603c78d98fb4-1.text: A deputy of the City Duma exercises the rights granted to them at meetings of the City Duma and its commissions in accordance with the Rules of Procedure of the City Duma.
ekb-ubda044603c78d98fb4-1.locator: Article 31. Basic rights of a deputy of the City Duma

ekb-u0307f1d582d53f64cb-1.text: A deputy of the City Duma or a group of deputies may address a deputy’s interpellation to the Head of Yekaterinburg, officials of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg, representatives of oblast executive authorities within the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”, and heads of state authorities of Sverdlovsk Oblast.

ekb-u7ca9199ba1844eb34f-1.text: The decision to recognize a deputy’s submission as a deputy’s interpellation is adopted by the City Duma.

ekb-u42caa7d23a696922d1-1.text: The Head of Yekaterinburg and officials of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg to whom a deputy’s interpellation is addressed must reply to it in writing no later than 25 days after its receipt.

ekb-ud03a934b7910c4db2e-1.text: Article 33. Submission by a deputy of the City Duma or a group of deputies
ekb-ud03a934b7910c4db2e-1.locator: Article 33. Submission by a deputy of the City Duma or a group of deputies

ekb-u9e398f4acc5c5c59d7-1.text: A deputy of the City Duma or a group of deputies of the City Duma may address a question or proposal to the Head of Yekaterinburg, officials of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg, representatives of oblast executive authorities within the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”, and heads of state authorities of Sverdlovsk Oblast.
ekb-u9e398f4acc5c5c59d7-1.locator: Article 33. Submission by a deputy of the City Duma or a group of deputies

ekb-uc99aacdc3f7d4824df-1.text: The deputy or group of deputies delivers the submission in writing to the Chair of the City Duma; this constitutes grounds for inviting its addressees or their representatives to a meeting of the City Duma in accordance with its Rules of Procedure.
ekb-uc99aacdc3f7d4824df-1.locator: Article 33. Submission by a deputy of the City Duma or a group of deputies

ekb-u0a7fe197a8f6d2ddd2-1.text: 1. The Head of Yekaterinburg is the highest official of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”, vested with their own powers to resolve matters of local significance. The Head of Yekaterinburg has powers to exercise specific state powers transferred by federal laws and laws of Sverdlovsk Oblast.

ekb-u135c60bb4185103474-1.text: 2. The Head of Yekaterinburg is elected by the City Duma for a term of five years from among candidates presented by the Governor of Sverdlovsk Oblast and heads the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg.

ekb-ub4dbe41b006f176bba-1.text: 3. The powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg commence on the day of election by the City Duma and ceremonial assumption of office and cease on the day the City Duma of the new convocation holds the meeting at which the election of the Head of Yekaterinburg is considered.

ekb-u7af2da9a7eff62faee-1.text: The ceremonial assumption of office by the Head of Yekaterinburg includes taking the following oath: “I, (surname, first name, patronymic), upon assuming office as Head of Yekaterinburg, solemnly swear to observe the Constitution of the Russian Federation and federal laws, the Charter and laws of Sverdlovsk Oblast, and the Charter of the Urban Okrug Municipality ‘City of Yekaterinburg’, to exercise honestly and conscientiously the powers granted to me and perform the duties entrusted to me, and to serve faithfully the prosperity of the Municipality ‘City of Yekaterinburg’ and the well-being of its residents”.”.

ekb-u708058b595fc1919e7-1.text: 4. In their activities, the Head of Yekaterinburg is subject to oversight by, and accountable to, the population of the municipality and the City Duma. The Head of Yekaterinburg exercises their powers on a full-time basis.

ekb-u327b84c67fe8175d2d-1.text: 4-1. In accordance with the principle of unity of the system of public authority, the Head of Yekaterinburg simultaneously holds a state office of Sverdlovsk Oblast and a municipal office.

ekb-ub3c64af0d93f0cfc11-1.text: 5. The Head of Yekaterinburg must observe the restrictions and prohibitions and perform the duties established by Federal Law of 25 December 2008 No. 273-ФЗ ‘On Combating Corruption’, Federal Law of 3 December 2012 No. 230-ФЗ ‘On Monitoring the Compliance of Expenditures of Persons Holding State Offices and Other Persons with Their Income’, and Federal Law of 7 May 2013 No. 79-ФЗ ‘On Prohibiting Certain Categories of Persons from Opening and Holding Accounts (Deposits), Keeping Cash and Valuables in Foreign Banks Located outside the Territory of the Russian Federation, and Owning and/or Using Foreign Financial Instruments’.

ekb-u5e43744f12840bd78c-1.text: 6. The Head of Yekaterinburg is exempt from liability for failure to observe the restrictions, prohibitions and requirements for preventing or resolving conflicts of interest, and for failure to perform the duties, established by Federal Law of 6 October 2003 No. 131-ФЗ ‘On the General Principles of the Organization of Local Self-Government in the Russian Federation’ and other federal laws for the purpose of combating corruption, if such non-compliance and failure to perform duties are recognized as resulting from circumstances beyond their control according to the procedure provided for in parts 3–6 of Article 13 of Federal Law of 25 December 2008 No. 273-ФЗ ‘On Combating Corruption’.

ekb-u4cb2ad383bd62cc208-1.text: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg
ekb-u4cb2ad383bd62cc208-1.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u1e8cc1abcd3d637c27-1.text: 1. The Head of Yekaterinburg, as the highest official of the municipality, is vested, in accordance with this Article of the Charter, with their own powers to resolve matters of local significance:
ekb-u1e8cc1abcd3d637c27-1.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u6ad337beda78cd5a75-1.text: 1) represents the municipality in relations with state authorities, local self-government bodies and officials, citizens and organizations irrespective of their form of ownership;
ekb-u6ad337beda78cd5a75-1.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-uf530b61b2f895c2587-1.text: 2) represents the interests of the population of the municipality in relations with local self-government bodies and officials;
ekb-uf530b61b2f895c2587-1.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-uf646e8b0305f60cfce-1.text: 3) is the official representative of the municipality within the country and abroad;
ekb-uf646e8b0305f60cfce-1.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u2b1a3f8c31bf5c548e-1.text: 4) acts on behalf of the municipality without a power of attorney;
ekb-u2b1a3f8c31bf5c548e-1.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u4537f988df4325eab1-1.text: 5) determines the directions for developing the municipality’s regional, interregional, international and foreign economic relations;
ekb-u4537f988df4325eab1-1.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u88ab04626d1bd58d1a-1.text: 6) concludes contracts and agreements on behalf of the municipality;
ekb-u88ab04626d1bd58d1a-1.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-ua5736993cb82e5bcf1-1.text: 7) takes measures to ensure the protection of the municipality’s interests in courts and other state bodies;
ekb-ua5736993cb82e5bcf1-1.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u197592f7219af6f6e3-1.text: 8) organizes and ensures the exercise by local self-government bodies of powers to resolve matters of local significance and of specific state powers transferred to local self-government bodies by federal laws and laws of Sverdlovsk Oblast;
ekb-u197592f7219af6f6e3-1.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u0e33803b62a746bd5f-1.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u49fb649fefdd2e5e64-1.text: 10) signs and promulgates, according to the procedure determined by this Charter, normative decisions adopted by the City Duma;
ekb-u49fb649fefdd2e5e64-1.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u6fdb45b46b10a0c261-1.text: 11) has the right to reject decisions adopted by the City Duma and returns such acts to the City Duma with a reasoned justification for their rejection or proposals for amendments and additions;
ekb-u6fdb45b46b10a0c261-1.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u2875b55e79e05d5245-1.text: 12) may require the convening of an extraordinary meeting of the City Duma;
ekb-u2875b55e79e05d5245-1.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u0362a0b73f328694f1-1.text: 13) submits to the City Duma an annual report on the results of their own activities and those of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg, including the resolution of matters raised by the City Duma;
ekb-u0362a0b73f328694f1-1.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u74b1cb283704265d04-1.text: 14) issues resolutions and executive orders on matters assigned to their competence by this Charter in accordance with Federal Law of 6 October 2003 No. 131-ФЗ ‘On the General Principles of the Organization of Local Self-Government in the Russian Federation’ and other federal laws;
ekb-u74b1cb283704265d04-1.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u36f496aca14b40650a-1.text: 15) ensures publication of the normative legal acts issued by them that affect human and civil rights, freedoms and duties;
ekb-u36f496aca14b40650a-1.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-ubf8fe03bfb68ff43ed-1.text: 16) designates the local self-government body authorized to exercise powers in the sphere of municipal-private partnership in accordance with Federal Law of 13 July 2015 No. 224-ФЗ ‘On Public-Private Partnership and Municipal-Private Partnership in the Russian Federation and on Amendments to Certain Legislative Acts of the Russian Federation’;
ekb-ubf8fe03bfb68ff43ed-1.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-uf63e642831e67196a3-1.text: 17) directs the development and implementation of measures for civil defence, the prevention and response to emergencies, and the elimination of the consequences of natural disasters within the municipality;
ekb-uf63e642831e67196a3-1.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-ud41b111482eaec16d9-1.text: 18) participates in measures to prevent terrorism and to minimize and/or eliminate the consequences of its manifestations, organized by federal executive bodies and/or executive bodies of Sverdlovsk Oblast.
ekb-ud41b111482eaec16d9-1.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-ubab0af69de3c727342-1.text: 2. The Head of Yekaterinburg exercises the following powers of the head of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg:
ekb-ubab0af69de3c727342-1.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-uddb7248e6069c547b9-1.text: 1) directs the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg on the principle of sole authority;
ekb-uddb7248e6069c547b9-1.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-ue4718a50e2936fe7f5-1.text: 2) issues resolutions of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg on matters of local significance and matters related to the exercise of specific state powers transferred to the municipality’s local self-government bodies by federal laws and laws of Sverdlovsk Oblast, as well as executive orders of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg on the organization of its work;
ekb-ue4718a50e2936fe7f5-1.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-ue15059a3471dbdbcc5-1.text: 3) organizes the implementation of decisions of the City Duma within their competence;
ekb-ue15059a3471dbdbcc5-1.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u6fe9cb9c6a1aff7dd5-1.text: 4) organizes work to develop the draft budget (budget and medium-term financial plan) of the municipality and the draft strategy for its socio-economic development;
ekb-u6fe9cb9c6a1aff7dd5-1.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u146a8632ad311105fb-1.text: 5) administers the revenue and expenditure estimate of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg;
ekb-u146a8632ad311105fb-1.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u00b82ca27e6e46a690-1.text: 6) ensures and organizes the exercise by local self-government bodies of powers to resolve matters of local significance and of specific state powers transferred to local self-government bodies by federal laws and laws of Sverdlovsk Oblast;
ekb-u00b82ca27e6e46a690-1.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u23dd9ece39de359008-1.text: 7) organizes the exercise of specific state powers transferred to local self-government bodies by federal laws and laws of Sverdlovsk Oblast;
ekb-u23dd9ece39de359008-1.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u8a96dd86a5532382e3-1.text: 8) submits the draft strategy for the socio-economic development of the municipality to the City Duma for approval;
ekb-u8a96dd86a5532382e3-1.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u66e1fab27fdd0f6a09-1.text: 9) submits the draft municipal budget and the report on its execution to the City Duma for approval;
ekb-u66e1fab27fdd0f6a09-1.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u1eaaaa1737fc40eb15-1.text: 10) submits to the City Duma draft decisions, or gives opinions on draft decisions of the City Duma, providing for the establishment, introduction and termination of local taxes, the establishment of local tax benefits and the grounds and procedure for their application, and expenditure from the local budget;
ekb-u1eaaaa1737fc40eb15-1.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u8c178d5481699a0301-1.text: 11) submits to the City Duma draft decisions determining the procedure for managing and disposing of municipally owned property;
ekb-u8c178d5481699a0301-1.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u4a3a60288368e49e3c-1.text: 12) submits to the City Duma drafts of other decisions whose adoption falls within the competence of the City Duma;
ekb-u4a3a60288368e49e3c-1.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-uc4f8f82bc135366aa8-1.text: 13) submits the structure of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg to the City Duma for approval and forms the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg;
ekb-uc4f8f82bc135366aa8-1.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u5221be4e329eafeed8-1.text: 14) adopts decisions on preparing the municipality’s draft master plan and draft land-use and development rules, as well as decisions on preparing proposals to amend the municipality’s master plan and land-use and development rules;
ekb-u5221be4e329eafeed8-1.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u5328b3a2fb0edeb621-1.text: 15) approves the composition and operating procedure of the commission for preparing the municipality’s draft land-use and development rules;
ekb-u5328b3a2fb0edeb621-1.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u98eb081f5db4f7e843-1.text: 16) appoints and removes from their posts municipal servants holding municipal-service posts in the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg and other employees of that Administration, unless otherwise provided for by municipal legal acts;
ekb-u98eb081f5db4f7e843-1.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-ub386d34ecdddc71657-1.text: 17) applies incentives and disciplinary measures to municipal servants holding municipal-service posts in the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg and other employees of that Administration, unless otherwise provided for by municipal legal acts;
ekb-ub386d34ecdddc71657-1.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u0fd61dfad0a473f3ab-1.text: 18) organizes the protection of public order within the municipality;
ekb-u0fd61dfad0a473f3ab-1.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-ufdb95f11f25923c640-1.text: 19) ensures primary fire-safety measures within the boundaries of the municipality and the activities of the municipal fire service;
ekb-ufdb95f11f25923c640-1.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u78373fa225949b29fc-1.text: 20) organizes professional education and additional professional education for municipal servants holding municipal-service posts in the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg and employees of municipal institutions;
ekb-u78373fa225949b29fc-1.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u34ada81ccef93361f8-1.text: 21) may be a member of the governing bodies of a business entity in which the municipality holds shares or an interest in the authorized capital, and participate in managing its affairs (without receiving personal income);
ekb-u34ada81ccef93361f8-1.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u843ec171765d7d8fa9-1.text: 22) delegates to municipal servants powers to participate in the governing bodies of business entities (without receiving personal income) in which the municipality holds shares or an interest in the authorized capital;
ekb-u843ec171765d7d8fa9-1.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u64da8f2903fab91fbf-1.text: 23) exercises other powers established by federal laws and laws of Sverdlovsk Oblast, this Charter and decisions of the City Duma.
ekb-u64da8f2903fab91fbf-1.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-ucc3dbfd141c6dc9d32-1.text: 3. The Head of Yekaterinburg also exercises other powers assigned to them by federal legislation, legislation of Sverdlovsk Oblast, this Charter and decisions of the City Duma.
ekb-ucc3dbfd141c6dc9d32-1.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u5f608235bbc2d3c853-1.text: 4. The Head of Yekaterinburg may form permanent (temporary) collegial and public bodies (collegia, councils, committees, commissions and others) to discuss and prepare decisions on matters of local significance of the municipality.
ekb-u5f608235bbc2d3c853-1.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u4598c15cbd0f556e9a-1.text: 5. During the temporary absence of the Head of Yekaterinburg, the powers provided for by point 2 of this Article of the Charter are exercised, on the Head’s executive order, by the First Deputy Head of Yekaterinburg or one of the Deputy Heads of Yekaterinburg.
ekb-u4598c15cbd0f556e9a-1.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u69400925e7835422a1-1.text: 6. The Head of Yekaterinburg may not:
ekb-u69400925e7835422a1-1.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u110cb220ba9c02e1b4-1.text: 1) engage in entrepreneurial activities personally or through authorized representatives; participate in managing a commercial or non-profit organization, except in the following cases:
ekb-u110cb220ba9c02e1b4-1.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-ub32a97e7cb335fe688-1.text: unpaid participation in managing a political party or a trade union body, including the elected body of a primary trade union organization established in a local self-government body; participation in a congress (conference) or general meeting of another public organization, a housing, housing-construction or garage cooperative, or an association of real estate owners;
ekb-ub32a97e7cb335fe688-1.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-ub5d0ba65de266602d6-1.text: unpaid participation in managing a non-profit organization (other than participation in managing a political party or a trade union body, including the elected body of a primary trade union organization established in a local self-government body, or participation in a congress (conference) or general meeting of another public organization, a housing, housing-construction or garage cooperative, or an association of real estate owners), with prior notification of the Governor of Sverdlovsk Oblast according to the procedure established by a law of Sverdlovsk Oblast;
ekb-ub5d0ba65de266602d6-1.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-ubcdbf13f2830fa054b-1.text: unpaid representation of the municipality’s interests in the council of municipalities of Sverdlovsk Oblast, other associations of municipalities, and their governing bodies;
ekb-ubcdbf13f2830fa054b-1.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u83bed66d5c621e4752-1.text: unpaid representation of the municipality’s interests in the governing bodies and audit commission of an organization whose founder (shareholder, member) is the municipality, in accordance with municipal legal acts determining the procedure for exercising the powers of an organization’s founder on behalf of the municipality or the procedure for managing municipally owned shares (interests in authorized capital);
ekb-u83bed66d5c621e4752-1.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u73186309fea90a4528-1.text: other cases provided for by federal laws;
ekb-u73186309fea90a4528-1.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-uea1e27941149e63ade-1.text: 2) engage in other paid activities, except teaching, scientific and other creative activities. Teaching, scientific and other creative activities may not be financed exclusively from funds of foreign states, international and foreign organizations, foreign citizens and stateless persons, unless otherwise provided for by an international treaty of the Russian Federation or legislation of the Russian Federation;
ekb-uea1e27941149e63ade-1.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u66acc07c1df18380a9-1.text: 3) be a member of governing bodies, boards of trustees or supervisory boards, or other bodies of foreign non-profit non-governmental organizations and their structural subdivisions operating within the Russian Federation, unless otherwise provided for by an international treaty of the Russian Federation or legislation of the Russian Federation.
ekb-u66acc07c1df18380a9-1.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u30d1b25daab060d61c-1.text: Article 36. Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg
ekb-u30d1b25daab060d61c-1.locator: Article 36. Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u9a9c2bdd49dd1425ea-1.text: 1. The Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg is the municipality’s executive and administrative local self-government body, vested with its own powers to resolve matters of local significance.
ekb-u9a9c2bdd49dd1425ea-1.locator: Article 36. Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u74f8ad5bd402c6f91c-1.text: 2. The Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg is directed by the Head of Yekaterinburg on the principle of sole authority. The Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg is subject to oversight by, and accountable to, the City Duma.
ekb-u74f8ad5bd402c6f91c-1.locator: Article 36. Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg

ekb-ua527df9e14de5e0af8-1.text: 3. The Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg has the rights of a legal entity.
ekb-ua527df9e14de5e0af8-1.locator: Article 36. Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u7992510c011f9efd8c-1.text: 4. The legal acts of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg are resolutions and executive orders.
ekb-u7992510c011f9efd8c-1.locator: Article 36. Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u61418fb05bdcf6f5ee-1.text: 5. Officials of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg issue executive orders and administrative orders on matters concerning their activities.
ekb-u61418fb05bdcf6f5ee-1.locator: Article 36. Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg

ekb-ue8b343021885680c82-1.text: 6. Expenditure to support the activities of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg is provided for as a separate line in the municipal budget in accordance with the expenditure classification of the budgets of the Russian Federation.
ekb-ue8b343021885680c82-1.locator: Article 36. Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u38a24efff92902124c-1.text: Article 37. Powers of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg
ekb-u38a24efff92902124c-1.locator: Article 37. Powers of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u04dbba23a1c98bcdb0-1.text: 1. The Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg exercises all executive and administrative powers concerning matters of local significance of the municipality in accordance with federal and oblast legislation, decisions of the City Duma and legal acts of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg, including:
ekb-u04dbba23a1c98bcdb0-1.locator: Article 37. Powers of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg

ekb-ua2c64c8c52e88f211e-1.text: 1) ensures the preparation of, and prepares, the draft municipal budget (the draft municipal budget and medium-term financial plan), and ensures execution of the municipal budget and preparation of budget reporting;
ekb-ua2c64c8c52e88f211e-1.locator: Article 37. Powers of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg

ekb-ufe87d8c271962349e0-1.text: 1-1) establishes the procedure for developing an action plan to implement the municipality’s socio-economic development strategy, the procedure for preparing a forecast of the municipality’s socio-economic development, and the forms and procedure for preparing the municipality’s medium-term financial plan;
ekb-ufe87d8c271962349e0-1.locator: Article 37. Powers of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u8cc686e9a7f8274fb7-1.text: 1-2) establishes the procedure for adopting decisions to develop municipal programmes and the procedure for drawing up municipal assignments;
ekb-u8cc686e9a7f8274fb7-1.locator: Article 37. Powers of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u0d33cbc54edb522809-1.text: 2) undertakes municipal borrowing, issues municipal guarantees and manages municipal debt;
ekb-u0d33cbc54edb522809-1.locator: Article 37. Powers of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u55079e304d9d096e9f-1.text: 3) issues municipal bonds and other securities according to the procedure established by current legislation and the City Duma;
ekb-u55079e304d9d096e9f-1.locator: Article 37. Powers of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u89c3b4911e4b0c24c9-1.text: 4) develops the draft strategy for the municipality’s socio-economic development and ensures implementation of the approved strategy;
ekb-u89c3b4911e4b0c24c9-1.locator: Article 37. Powers of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u15f725f9f2b6ad4e84-1.text: 4-1) develops and approves an action plan to implement the municipality’s socio-economic development strategy and municipal programmes to be implemented using municipal budget funds, ensures their implementation and prepares reports on their implementation;
ekb-u15f725f9f2b6ad4e84-1.locator: Article 37. Powers of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u866ee0626b684b2bae-1.text: 4-2) prepares and approves a forecast of the municipality’s socio-economic development;
ekb-u866ee0626b684b2bae-1.locator: Article 37. Powers of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg

ekb-ud094493f6b73e9cab7-1.text: 5) develops and implements the municipality’s financial and investment policy and takes measures to support and develop entrepreneurship;
ekb-ud094493f6b73e9cab7-1.locator: Article 37. Powers of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u1aa126cb88dc957615-1.text: 6) develops the procedure for possessing, using and disposing of municipally owned property;
ekb-u1aa126cb88dc957615-1.locator: Article 37. Powers of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg

ekb-ue8fcb1bfbd0f673661-1.text: 7) develops the procedure for adopting decisions on the establishment, reorganization and liquidation of municipal enterprises and institutions;
ekb-ue8fcb1bfbd0f673661-1.locator: Article 37. Powers of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg

ekb-ube6ac722936babca64-1.text: 8) is the body authorized to select suppliers (service providers, contractors) for contracting authorities;
ekb-ube6ac722936babca64-1.locator: Article 37. Powers of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg

ekb-ua760d34c1cfbcb25e3-1.text: 9) possesses, uses and disposes of municipally owned property, including municipal land;
ekb-ua760d34c1cfbcb25e3-1.locator: Article 37. Powers of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg

ekb-ucc6f249718def65f49-1.locator: Article 37. Powers of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg

ekb-ufaadc4624cd9578fe8-1.text: 10-1) develops and approves the layout scheme for non-stationary trading facilities according to the procedure established by the authorized executive body of Sverdlovsk Oblast;
ekb-ufaadc4624cd9578fe8-1.locator: Article 37. Powers of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u569eead3a23c153a2b-1.text: 11) organizes and directs the consumer protection system in the municipality;
ekb-u569eead3a23c153a2b-1.locator: Article 37. Powers of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u4b502ccf823a88d8a8-1.text: 12) provides organizational and logistical support for the preparation and conduct of municipal elections, local referendums, voting to recall the Head of Yekaterinburg, and voting on changes to the municipality’s boundaries and on transformation of the municipality;
ekb-u4b502ccf823a88d8a8-1.locator: Article 37. Powers of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u0dd2af1eddbd612fca-1.text: 13) participates in activities relating to guardianship and trusteeship;
ekb-u0dd2af1eddbd612fca-1.locator: Article 37. Powers of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg

ekb-ub87c063773b8aa8703-1.text: 13-1) participates in preventing terrorism and extremism and in minimizing and/or eliminating the consequences of manifestations of terrorism and extremism within the boundaries of the municipality, including:
ekb-ub87c063773b8aa8703-1.locator: Article 37. Powers of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg

ekb-ue015205bbc62fad81f-1.text: develops and implements municipal programmes for preventing terrorism and minimizing and/or eliminating the consequences of its manifestations;
ekb-ue015205bbc62fad81f-1.locator: Article 37. Powers of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg

ekb-ue7e96eee46ea2237bd-1.text: organizes and conducts information and awareness-raising activities in the municipality to explain the nature of terrorism and its danger to society and to foster citizens’ rejection of terrorist ideology, including through the distribution of information materials and printed products, explanatory work and other activities;
ekb-ue7e96eee46ea2237bd-1.locator: Article 37. Powers of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg

ekb-uf91d53ef4a175b9a7e-1.text: participates in measures to prevent terrorism and to minimize and/or eliminate the consequences of its manifestations, organized by federal executive bodies and/or executive bodies of Sverdlovsk Oblast;
ekb-uf91d53ef4a175b9a7e-1.locator: Article 37. Powers of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u436751ad2897823b36-1.text: ensures compliance with anti-terrorist protection requirements for facilities that are municipally owned or under the jurisdiction of the municipality’s local self-government bodies;
ekb-u436751ad2897823b36-1.locator: Article 37. Powers of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u46b89a8f319ffb0265-1.text: submits proposals to executive bodies of Sverdlovsk Oblast on participation in preventing terrorism and in minimizing and/or eliminating the consequences of its manifestations;
ekb-u46b89a8f319ffb0265-1.locator: Article 37. Powers of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg

ekb-ueef8534f354f7cfcb5-1.text: exercises other powers to resolve matters of local significance concerning participation in preventing terrorism and in minimizing and/or eliminating the consequences of its manifestations;
ekb-ueef8534f354f7cfcb5-1.locator: Article 37. Powers of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u673772076aac7e926a-1.text: 14) exercises other powers to resolve matters of local significance of the municipality in accordance with federal and oblast legislation and this Charter.
ekb-u673772076aac7e926a-1.locator: Article 37. Powers of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u1e48ef12a6d6a79f9d-1.text: 2. The Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg exercises specific state powers where they are transferred by federal laws and laws of Sverdlovsk Oblast according to the established procedure.
ekb-u1e48ef12a6d6a79f9d-1.locator: Article 37. Powers of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg

ekb-ua6c72c101f9786af87-1.text: Article 38. Structure of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg
ekb-ua6c72c101f9786af87-1.locator: Article 38. Structure of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u4179074bd05a218d94-1.text: 1. The structure of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg is developed by the Head of Yekaterinburg and approved by the City Duma. The staffing schedule of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg and the standard structure of district administrations are established independently by the Head of Yekaterinburg.
ekb-u4179074bd05a218d94-1.locator: Article 38. Structure of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg

ekb-ub633f636d8f97eb23a-1.text: 2. Within the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg, posts are established for the First Deputy Head, Deputy Heads of Yekaterinburg, the Deputy Head of Yekaterinburg — Chief of Staff of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg or the Chief of Staff of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg, and heads of district administrations; their powers are determined by the Head of Yekaterinburg.
ekb-ub633f636d8f97eb23a-1.locator: Article 38. Structure of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u89587d07dbadbb5c52-1.text: 3. The structure of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg consists of sectoral (functional) and territorial bodies.
ekb-u89587d07dbadbb5c52-1.locator: Article 38. Structure of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg

ekb-ue69cd7bd3b02dba572-1.text: 4. Sectoral (functional) bodies of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg exercise powers to manage sectors of the local economy and the social sphere.
ekb-ue69cd7bd3b02dba572-1.locator: Article 38. Structure of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg

ekb-ue6d13d486657f67b5b-1.text: 5. A body of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg for municipal property management is formed to support the activities of the Head of Yekaterinburg and the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg in managing and disposing of municipal property and acquiring and exercising the municipality’s property rights and obligations.
ekb-ue6d13d486657f67b5b-1.locator: Article 38. Structure of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u769558d3adaeb053b3-1.text: 6. A financial body of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg with the rights of a legal entity is established to support the activities of the Head of Yekaterinburg and the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg in drawing up and executing the municipal budget, monitoring its execution and preparing budget reporting.
ekb-u769558d3adaeb053b3-1.locator: Article 38. Structure of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u19504a244b9249747a-1.text: 7. The territorial bodies of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg are district administrations.
ekb-u19504a244b9249747a-1.locator: Article 38. Structure of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg

ekb-uc3842deaccd5e57c04-1.text: 8. To provide organizational, legal, information, financial, documentary and logistical support for the activities of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg, its staff is formed, headed by the Deputy Head of Yekaterinburg — Chief of Staff of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg or by the Chief of Staff of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg
ekb-uc3842deaccd5e57c04-1.locator: Article 38. Structure of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg

ekb-ufbfefc40ae8fc8e2e9-1.text: 9. The organization of work and powers of bodies of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg that do not have the rights of a legal entity are determined by regulations on those bodies approved by legal acts of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg.
ekb-ufbfefc40ae8fc8e2e9-1.locator: Article 38. Structure of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg

ekb-uab1c255553dd44ef98-1.text: 10. Bodies of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg may be established and granted the rights of a legal entity by a decision of the City Duma. Regulations on such bodies of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg are approved by the City Duma on the submission of the Head of Yekaterinburg.
ekb-uab1c255553dd44ef98-1.locator: Article 38. Structure of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg

ekb-ude0953975f662bd223-1.text: Article 38-1. Repealed. — Decision of the Yekaterinburg City Duma of 25.05.2018 No. 11/81.
ekb-ude0953975f662bd223-1.locator: Article 38. Structure of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg

ekb-ud73b2c05a1c1d57956-1.text: Article 39. Officials of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg
ekb-ud73b2c05a1c1d57956-1.locator: Article 39. Officials of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg

ekb-uab5977c89248c24ae8-1.text: 1. Appointed officials of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg are municipal servants with an established range of duties to support the powers of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg and responsibility for performing those duties, vested with executive and administrative powers to resolve matters of local significance of the municipality and/or organize the activities of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg.
ekb-uab5977c89248c24ae8-1.locator: Article 39. Officials of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u72eb5ab4e39c640faf-1.text: 2. Officials appointed by the Head of Yekaterinburg include the First Deputy Head of Yekaterinburg, Deputy Heads of Yekaterinburg, the Deputy Head of Yekaterinburg — Chief of Staff of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg or the Chief of Staff of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg, heads of district administrations and their deputies, and heads of bodies of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg.
ekb-u72eb5ab4e39c640faf-1.locator: Article 39. Officials of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg

ekb-uf8de72000c0e4b5faa-1.text: 3. Fixed-term employment contracts are concluded with all appointed officials for the term of office of the Head of Yekaterinburg in accordance with federal laws.
ekb-uf8de72000c0e4b5faa-1.locator: Article 39. Officials of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u0359219d4f5fcb03c4-1.text: 4. The procedure for appointing officials of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg is established by the Head of Yekaterinburg.
ekb-u0359219d4f5fcb03c4-1.locator: Article 39. Officials of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg

ekb-uf8817d844887f888d5-1.text: 5. Repealed. — Decision of the Yekaterinburg City Duma of 28.01.2014 No. 1/9.
ekb-uf8817d844887f888d5-1.locator: Article 39. Officials of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u08355676f6127f4940-1.text: Article 40. Collegium of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg
ekb-u08355676f6127f4940-1.locator: Article 40. Collegium of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u4d19801f6c282ecfaa-1.text: 1. The Collegium of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg is a permanent body established under the Head of Yekaterinburg to conduct collective discussion and develop decisions on the municipality’s most important matters of local significance.
ekb-u4d19801f6c282ecfaa-1.locator: Article 40. Collegium of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u988a51d8c53427972a-1.text: 2. The Head of Yekaterinburg forms the Collegium of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg and directs its work.
ekb-u988a51d8c53427972a-1.locator: Article 40. Collegium of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u215a52ddad2541745e-1.text: 3. The Collegium includes, ex officio, the First Deputy Head of Yekaterinburg, Deputy Heads of Yekaterinburg, the Deputy Head of Yekaterinburg — Chief of Staff of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg or the Chief of Staff of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg, heads of district administrations, the Director of the Finance Department and the Director of the Economy Department. Other officials may be included in the Collegium of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg by executive order of the Head of Yekaterinburg.
ekb-u215a52ddad2541745e-1.locator: Article 40. Collegium of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u67be0c51afcf379474-1.text: 4. Deputies of the City Duma and representatives of public organizations, mass media and territorial public self-government may participate in meetings of the Collegium of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg.
ekb-u67be0c51afcf379474-1.locator: Article 40. Collegium of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u864dbffeda9fa5cc32-1.text: 5. Meetings of the Collegium of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg are generally held at least once a month.
ekb-u864dbffeda9fa5cc32-1.locator: Article 40. Collegium of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u937f9c8abb2779021b-1.text: 6. The powers of the Collegium and the procedures for its work and preparation of decisions are determined by regulations approved by a legal act of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg.
ekb-u937f9c8abb2779021b-1.locator: Article 40. Collegium of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u5ba1a6b80d09521caa-1.text: 1. A district administration exercises executive and administrative powers within the territory of the municipality’s district, within the competence established by the Head of Yekaterinburg.

ekb-ud9c624790d2b0ac6e8-1.text: 2. The activities of a district administration are directed by the head of the district administration.

ekb-ue982b36ae6c237798f-1.text: 3. The head of a district administration is appointed by the Head of Yekaterinburg.

ekb-u977c4c9f264ae027e9-1.text: 4. Regulations on a district administration are approved by the City Duma.

ekb-udd38b601739ff9890d-1.text: 5. A district administration has the right to establish structural subdivisions within it. Its structure is developed by the head of the district administration on the basis of the standard structure and approved by a legal act of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg.

ekb-u80feafb7b62d191488-1.text: 6. Expenditure on maintaining a district administration is provided for in the municipal budget.

ekb-u16639db0df690dfb62-1.text: 7. A district administration has the rights of a legal entity.

ekb-u777b7f49b1f7518dc0-1.text: 8. Repealed. — Decision of the Yekaterinburg City Duma of 23.10.2012 No. 42/64.

ekb-ub683c1910119828c8b-1.text: 1. The Chamber of Accounts is a permanent body of external municipal financial control.

ekb-uafb73077cdd2068c05-1.text: 2. The Chamber of Accounts is formed by the City Duma and is accountable to it.

ekb-u7dd1f4df300da4712a-1.text: 3. The Chamber of Accounts comprises its Chair, Deputy Chair, auditors and staff.

ekb-u7df9fbe7543de9ab8c-1.text: The structure of the Chamber of Accounts is determined according to the procedure established by a normative legal act of the City Duma. Its staffing level is determined by a legal act of the City Duma on the submission of the Chair of the Chamber of Accounts, taking into account the need to exercise the powers assigned by legislation and to ensure the organizational and functional independence of the Chamber of Accounts.

ekb-u0cbe888d0296d945dc-1.text: The posts of Chair, Deputy Chair and auditors of the Chamber of Accounts are municipal offices.

ekb-u08787c8d70af5d9b00-1.text: 4. The Chair, Deputy Chair and auditors of the Chamber of Accounts are appointed by the City Duma for a term of 5 years.

ekb-uc5335976b31779d26c-1.text: Proposals for candidates for the post of Chair of the Chamber of Accounts are submitted to the City Duma by:

ekb-u55e9c051ecb68015ca-1.text: the Chair of the City Duma;

ekb-u76f31695be0b2f86d9-1.text: deputies of the City Duma numbering at least one third of the established number of deputies of the City Duma.

ekb-u1b82e7f6dcfb599ee2-1.text: Proposals for candidates for the posts of Deputy Chair and auditors of the Chamber of Accounts are submitted to the City Duma according to the procedure established by the Regulations on the Chamber of Accounts approved by the City Duma.

ekb-ub6b54287b7c6a990f4-1.text: 5. The Chamber of Accounts has the rights of a legal entity.

ekb-ue5f9765c66109ae8c8-1.text: 6. The organization and activities of the Chamber of Accounts are governed by the Federal Law ‘On the General Principles of the Organization and Activities of Control and Accounts Bodies of the Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation and Municipalities’, the Federal Law ‘On the General Principles of the Organization of Local Self-Government in the Russian Federation’, the Budget Code of the Russian Federation, other federal laws and other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation, the Regulations on the Chamber of Accounts approved by the City Duma, and other municipal normative legal acts. In the cases and according to the procedure established by federal laws, the organization and activities of the Chamber of Accounts are also legally regulated by laws of Sverdlovsk Oblast.

ekb-uc93b10ca7ebb80d40e-1.text: 7. The Chamber of Accounts exercises the following principal powers:

ekb-ucca8fb659caae36248-1.text: 1) organizing and exercising control over the legality and efficiency of the use of municipal budget funds and, in cases provided for by legislation of the Russian Federation, other funds;

ekb-u4ecba5874c171d141a-1.text: 2) expert examination of draft municipal budgets, verification and analysis of the justification for their indicators;

ekb-u76b73062c43db89b22-1.text: 3) external verification of the annual report on execution of the municipal budget;

ekb-u352d045023553e82d2-1.text: 4) conducting audits in the procurement of goods, works and services in accordance with Federal Law of 5 April 2013 No. 44-ФЗ ‘On the Contract System in the Procurement of Goods, Works and Services to Meet State and Municipal Needs’;

ekb-ua714166b5078f19425-1.text: 5) assessing the efficiency of the formation, management and disposal of municipal property and monitoring compliance with the established procedure for the formation, management and disposal of such property (including exclusive rights to the results of intellectual activity);

ekb-u20b93ef53c0a49a9ca-1.text: 6) assessing the efficiency of granting tax and other benefits and advantages and budget loans funded from the municipal budget, as well as assessing the legality of providing municipal guarantees and sureties or securing the performance of obligations by other means for transactions entered into by legal entities and individual entrepreneurs using municipal budget funds and municipally owned property;

ekb-ub95e2ce9f9a4074445-1.text: 7) expert examination of draft municipal legal acts insofar as they concern the municipality’s expenditure obligations, expert examination of draft municipal legal acts that change municipal budget revenues, and of municipal programmes (draft municipal programmes);

ekb-u15334b876d23f911c9-1.text: 8) analysis and monitoring of the budget process in the municipality, including preparation of proposals to eliminate identified deviations in the budget process and improve the budget legislation of the Russian Federation;

ekb-u17935c3136a8f8d159-1.text: 9) conducting ongoing analysis of execution and monitoring the organization of execution of the municipal budget in the current financial year, and submitting quarterly information to the City Duma and the Head of Yekaterinburg on the progress of municipal budget execution and the results of control and expert-analytical activities carried out;

ekb-u9f82a5d720aed82848-1.text: 10) monitoring the state of municipal domestic and external debt;

ekb-u3319533a12f53aa4be-1.text: 11) assessing, within the competence of the Chamber of Accounts, the feasibility, risks and results of achieving the municipality’s socio-economic development objectives provided for in its strategic planning documents;

ekb-ueaf06f32dc8f3f80a9-1.text: 12) participating, within its powers, in measures aimed at combating corruption;

ekb-u730bd108a9040e2178-1.text: 13) other powers in the sphere of external municipal financial control established by federal laws, laws of Sverdlovsk Oblast, this Charter and normative legal acts of the City Duma.

ekb-ufe31e762e3df2a4ff9-1.text: The Chamber of Accounts is a subject of rule-making initiative and may introduce drafts of municipal legal acts.

ekb-u23f431e22671ab2465-1.text: 8. External municipal financial control is exercised by the Chamber of Accounts:

ekb-u34b281774ac12c15c1-1.text: 1) in relation to local self-government bodies and municipal bodies, municipal institutions and unitary enterprises, and other organizations if they use municipally owned property;

ekb-uf448d7b9da9a7c5725-1.text: 2) in relation to other persons in the cases provided for by the Budget Code of the Russian Federation and other federal laws.

ekb-uf0c2cb7f3568ffe3b0-1.text: 9. The activities of the Chamber of Accounts are financed from the municipal budget.

ekb-ueb794c6be1c1fc5fcb-1.text: 10. Measures for the material and social provision of the Chair, Deputy Chair, auditors, inspectors and other staff of the Chamber of Accounts are established by municipal legal acts of the municipality in accordance with the Federal Law ‘On the General Principles of the Organization and Activities of Control and Accounts Bodies of the Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation and Municipalities’, other federal laws and laws of Sverdlovsk Oblast.

ekb-uc0c95190f5ec784912-1.text: Officials of the Chamber of Accounts are guaranteed monetary remuneration (compensation), annual paid leave (basic and additional), professional development, including additional professional education, and other material and social provision measures established for persons holding municipal offices and municipal-service posts in the municipality.

ekb-u6d3e7c2345533d16d3-1.text: 1. Municipal service is the professional activity of citizens carried out on a permanent basis in municipal-service posts filled by concluding an employment agreement (contract).

ekb-uc59cc38f53377ff772-1.text: 2. Municipal-service posts are established by municipal legal acts in accordance with the register of municipal-service posts approved by a law of Sverdlovsk Oblast.

ekb-u715e92b9a8e1e4fda7-1.text: 3. A citizen enters municipal service through appointment to a municipal-service post under the terms of an employment contract in accordance with labour legislation, taking into account the special provisions of legislation on municipal service.

ekb-uad610211e3355cf8fa-1.text: 4. Qualification requirements concerning the level of professional education, length of municipal service or length of work in a speciality or field of training necessary to hold municipal-service posts are established by municipal legal acts on the basis of standard qualification requirements for municipal-service posts, which are determined by a law of Sverdlovsk Oblast in accordance with the classification of municipal-service posts, except for certain municipal-service posts whose qualification requirements are established by federal laws and/or other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation.

ekb-u258452be669b4aeedb-1.text: Qualification requirements concerning the knowledge and skills necessary to perform official duties, as well as the speciality and field of training, are established in accordance with federal law.

ekb-ufc67b6c26866496ef5-1.text: 5. The rights and duties of municipal servants are established by the federal law on municipal service.

ekb-u5e80983b0ef3e2584a-1.text: 6. A municipal servant is granted guarantees in accordance with federal legislation.

ekb-u8ee77ab9007e04fa5f-1.text: 7. A municipal servant is granted the following additional guarantees:

ekb-ud409e3a27b463d4ce5-1.text: allocation of subsidies for the purchase and construction of housing from the funds of the relevant local budget;

ekb-u486f975da36f1ed1a7-1.text: monetary reimbursement of transport expenses or provision of official transport, taking into account the content and extent of the official duties performed;

ekb-ube1c017474560345ff-1.text: monetary reimbursement of representation expenses according to the procedure and in the amounts determined by the City Duma;

ekb-u594ce8c989de718c26-1.text: a supplement to the state pension according to the procedure and in the amounts determined by the City Duma.

ekb-ud1c274b1531635e96f-1.text: Article 42-1. Guarantees for the exercise of the powers of deputies of the City Duma and the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u33920942406ab90baf-1.text: The following guarantees for the exercise of the powers of deputies of the City Duma and the Head of Yekaterinburg are established at the expense of the municipal budget:

ekb-u9f5b801ed6ee0aebfb-1.text: 1) access to information necessary to exercise the powers of deputies of the City Duma and the Head of Yekaterinburg, according to the procedure established by municipal legal acts in accordance with federal and oblast legislation;

ekb-u994f23cfc9e6845605-1.text: 2) use, for exercising the powers of deputies of the City Duma and the Head of Yekaterinburg, of official premises, communications facilities and office equipment intended to support the activities of the City Duma and the Head of Yekaterinburg;

ekb-ue09fdf9377f04acaa8-1.text: 3) transport services necessary to exercise the powers of deputies of the City Duma and the Head of Yekaterinburg, according to the procedure established by municipal legal acts;

ekb-u1bef11c8fe4344aae9-1.text: 4) professional education and additional professional education for a deputy of the City Duma and the Head of Yekaterinburg;

ekb-u3dd655cbf39640a043-1.text: 5) provision of supplementary pension benefits, taking into account the period of exercise of their powers and according to the procedure and conditions established by municipal legal acts, to a citizen who has ceased exercising the powers of a deputy of the City Duma or the Head of Yekaterinburg, who exercised those powers on a full-time basis and reached pensionable age or lost capacity for work while exercising powers in one of those offices (except where those powers were terminated on one or more grounds involving failure to observe restrictions or prohibitions or to perform duties, upon termination on which federal law bars the provision to citizens who held those offices of additional social or other guarantees in connection with the termination of their powers);

ekb-u27237ff3b8aaac6599-1.text: 6) timely payment in full of salaries to deputies of the City Duma and the Head of Yekaterinburg who exercise their powers on a full-time basis, in the amounts and according to the procedure established by municipal legal acts;

ekb-u540d8ebcf3b2890329-1.text: 7) granting to deputies of the City Duma and the Head of Yekaterinburg who exercise their powers on a full-time basis annual basic paid leave and annual additional paid leave, the duration of which is determined by municipal legal acts;

ekb-uf43a4307e24b041a7d-1.text: 8) reimbursement to deputies of the City Duma of telephone service expenses and other documented expenses connected with the exercise of their powers, in the amounts and according to the procedure established by municipal legal acts, and compensation for expenses connected with carrying out deputies’ activities.
