ekb-u853f44b4e459d81845-1.text: A deputy of the City Duma is guaranteed retention of their job (post) for a period totalling six working days per month to exercise their powers on a non-full-time basis.

ekb-u6ad5aecb34b2fa1081-1.text: Article 43. Repealed. — Decision of the Yekaterinburg City Duma of 25.05.2018 No. 11/81.
ekb-u6ad5aecb34b2fa1081-1.locator: Article 43. Repealed. — Decision of the Yekaterinburg City Duma of 25.05.2018 No. 11/81.

ekb-u25312822fc08f059d4-1.text: Chapter VI. EARLY TERMINATION OF THE POWERS OF THE CITY DUMA,
ekb-u25312822fc08f059d4-1.locator: Chapter VI. EARLY TERMINATION OF THE POWERS OF THE CITY DUMA,

ekb-u0b3dcc1a67d294c863-1.text: THE HEAD OF YEKATERINBURG AND DEPUTIES OF THE CITY DUMA
ekb-u0b3dcc1a67d294c863-1.locator: Chapter VI. EARLY TERMINATION OF THE POWERS OF THE CITY DUMA,

ekb-u439ceb80e1abc522a4-1.text: Article 45. Early termination of the powers of the City Duma
ekb-u439ceb80e1abc522a4-1.locator: Article 45. Early termination of the powers of the City Duma

ekb-u9c7f7a0445daefd0bc-1.text: 1. The powers of the City Duma terminate early in the event of:
ekb-u9c7f7a0445daefd0bc-1.locator: Article 45. Early termination of the powers of the City Duma

ekb-u61bc3a6b2d8e5d22bc-1.text: 1) adoption by the City Duma of a decision on self-dissolution. The corresponding decision on self-dissolution is adopted by at least two thirds of the established number of deputies of the City Duma;
ekb-u61bc3a6b2d8e5d22bc-1.locator: Article 45. Early termination of the powers of the City Duma

ekb-uf01ad012627cacfee8-1.text: 2) entry into force of a court decision that the current composition of deputies of the City Duma lacks authority, including as a result of deputies of the City Duma resigning their powers;
ekb-uf01ad012627cacfee8-1.locator: Article 45. Early termination of the powers of the City Duma

ekb-u610eb0dffc8e354d8f-1.text: 3) transformation or abolition of the municipality;
ekb-u610eb0dffc8e354d8f-1.locator: Article 45. Early termination of the powers of the City Duma

ekb-u06341745d999dadb31-1.text: 4) dissolution of the City Duma according to the procedure and on the grounds provided for by federal legislation;
ekb-u06341745d999dadb31-1.locator: Article 45. Early termination of the powers of the City Duma

ekb-u06a6e43a5c04e90513-1.text: 5) failure to meet the deadline for issuing a municipal legal act necessary to implement a decision adopted through the population’s direct expression of will in accordance with federal legislation;
ekb-u06a6e43a5c04e90513-1.locator: Article 45. Early termination of the powers of the City Duma

ekb-u299996f014a560a126-1.text: 6) an increase of more than 25 percent in the number of voters in the municipality as a result of changes to the municipality’s boundaries or the merger of a settlement with an urban okrug.
ekb-u299996f014a560a126-1.locator: Article 45. Early termination of the powers of the City Duma

ekb-u08eb67a7fd07383daf-1.text: 2. Early termination of the powers of the City Duma entails early termination of the powers of its deputies.
ekb-u08eb67a7fd07383daf-1.locator: Article 45. Early termination of the powers of the City Duma

ekb-u43ac1ba018d5830eac-1.text: 3. In the event of early termination of the powers of the City Duma, early municipal elections are held according to the procedure and within the time limits established by electoral legislation.
ekb-u43ac1ba018d5830eac-1.locator: Article 45. Early termination of the powers of the City Duma

ekb-u0a640274c18a6a1d71-1.text: Article 46. Early termination of the powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg
ekb-u0a640274c18a6a1d71-1.locator: Article 46. Early termination of the powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-uf1e94b2d9e48cb6a06-1.text: 1. The powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg terminate early in the following cases:
ekb-uf1e94b2d9e48cb6a06-1.locator: Article 46. Early termination of the powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-ud4dc9ea4b311e154b5-1.locator: Article 46. Early termination of the powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u41e09bfc9a6f182c86-1.text: 2) removal from office in accordance with federal law;
ekb-u41e09bfc9a6f182c86-1.locator: Article 46. Early termination of the powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-ue22c062b21d0d0fdb7-1.text: 3) being declared legally incapable or of limited legal capacity by a court;
ekb-ue22c062b21d0d0fdb7-1.locator: Article 46. Early termination of the powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u07178a565799199048-1.text: 4) being declared missing or dead by a court;
ekb-u07178a565799199048-1.locator: Article 46. Early termination of the powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u5489de6d051747419c-1.text: 5) entry into legal force of a court judgment convicting them;
ekb-u5489de6d051747419c-1.locator: Article 46. Early termination of the powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u517fdc146a90ee680b-1.text: 6) departure from the Russian Federation for permanent residence abroad;
ekb-u517fdc146a90ee680b-1.locator: Article 46. Early termination of the powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u722aff47d16c4cf5fd-1.text: 7) termination of citizenship of the Russian Federation or citizenship of a foreign state that is a party to an international treaty of the Russian Federation under which a foreign citizen has the right to be elected to local self-government bodies; possession of citizenship (nationality) of a foreign state or of a residence permit or other document confirming the right of a citizen of the Russian Federation, or of a foreign citizen entitled under an international treaty of the Russian Federation to be elected to local self-government bodies, to permanent residence in a foreign state, unless otherwise provided for by an international treaty of the Russian Federation;
ekb-u722aff47d16c4cf5fd-1.locator: Article 46. Early termination of the powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u3cc3b765a79c9b9647-1.locator: Article 46. Early termination of the powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u078a90a62dfb39f8d8-1.text: 9) a court-established persistent inability, for health reasons, to exercise the powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg;
ekb-u078a90a62dfb39f8d8-1.locator: Article 46. Early termination of the powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-ua4e1322edc2fae3bd8-1.locator: Article 46. Early termination of the powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-uf7412ba10c56171062-1.text: 11) transformation or abolition of the municipality;
ekb-uf7412ba10c56171062-1.locator: Article 46. Early termination of the powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u63b8c2c5f829bfd627-1.text: 12) an increase of more than 25 percent in the number of voters in the municipality as a result of changes to the municipality’s boundaries or the merger of a settlement with an urban okrug;
ekb-u63b8c2c5f829bfd627-1.locator: Article 46. Early termination of the powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-ufb5d8727eba6232e41-1.locator: Article 46. Early termination of the powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u199d67a5bd0e6ab74e-1.text: 13) dismissal from office according to the procedure and on the grounds provided for by federal law.
ekb-u199d67a5bd0e6ab74e-1.locator: Article 46. Early termination of the powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u416945a576a172ba16-1.text: 2. A decision on early termination of the powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg on the ground provided for in subpoint 1 of point 1 of this Article of the Charter is adopted by the City Duma on the basis of the Head’s written application.
ekb-u416945a576a172ba16-1.locator: Article 46. Early termination of the powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u3611f67f9b658d6660-1.text: A decision on early termination of the powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg on the ground provided for in subpoint 13 of point 1 of this Article of the Charter is adopted by the City Duma on the initiative of deputies of the City Duma or the Governor of Sverdlovsk Oblast, according to the procedure and on the grounds provided for by federal law.
ekb-u3611f67f9b658d6660-1.locator: Article 46. Early termination of the powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-ub84066aeb83cea8f05-1.text: 3. The powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg also terminate early due to loss of the confidence of the President of the Russian Federation if the Head of Yekaterinburg, their spouse and minor children fail to comply with the prohibition established by Federal Law of 7 May 2013 No. 79-ФЗ ‘On Prohibiting Certain Categories of Persons from Opening and Holding Accounts (Deposits), Keeping Cash and Valuables in Foreign Banks Located outside the Territory of the Russian Federation, and Owning and/or Using Foreign Financial Instruments’.
ekb-ub84066aeb83cea8f05-1.locator: Article 46. Early termination of the powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-ub426e293b965f96555-1.text: 4. Repealed. — Decision of the Yekaterinburg City Duma of 09.12.2025 No. 39/43.
ekb-ub426e293b965f96555-1.locator: Article 46. Early termination of the powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-ud9fb91d3fc25a226e6-1.text: 5. In the event of early termination of the powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg, the Head of Yekaterinburg is elected no later than six months after the date of such termination.
ekb-ud9fb91d3fc25a226e6-1.locator: Article 46. Early termination of the powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-uc0497ed417ef2011a7-1.text: If less than six months remain before the expiry of the City Duma’s term of office, the Head of Yekaterinburg is elected from among candidates presented by the Governor of Sverdlovsk Oblast within three months of the date on which a legally competent composition of the City Duma is elected.
ekb-uc0497ed417ef2011a7-1.locator: Article 46. Early termination of the powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u9b1af319819b6fb29d-1.text: 6. If the Head of Yekaterinburg, whose powers were terminated early on the basis of a legal act of the Governor of Sverdlovsk Oblast removing them from office or a decision of the City Duma dismissing the Head of Yekaterinburg from office, challenges that legal act or decision in court, the City Duma may not adopt a decision on electing the Head of Yekaterinburg until the court decision enters into legal force.
ekb-u9b1af319819b6fb29d-1.locator: Article 46. Early termination of the powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-uca0e4556b5d84f383b-1.text: Article 46-1. Repealed. — Decision of the Yekaterinburg City Duma of 25.05.2018 No. 11/81.
ekb-uca0e4556b5d84f383b-1.locator: Article 46. Early termination of the powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u7a08792c91a3ef1004-1.text: Article 47. Early termination of the powers of a deputy of the City Duma
ekb-u7a08792c91a3ef1004-1.locator: Article 47. Early termination of the powers of a deputy of the City Duma

ekb-u67301f0efc368c2f4a-1.text: 1. The powers of a deputy of the City Duma terminate early in the following cases:
ekb-u67301f0efc368c2f4a-1.locator: Article 47. Early termination of the powers of a deputy of the City Duma

ekb-ud4dc9ea4b311e154b5-2.locator: Article 47. Early termination of the powers of a deputy of the City Duma

ekb-ued02b4d0335c21b3f4-1.text: 2) being declared legally incapable or of limited legal capacity by a court;
ekb-ued02b4d0335c21b3f4-1.locator: Article 47. Early termination of the powers of a deputy of the City Duma

ekb-uffea0e72c88a0313a2-1.text: 3) being declared missing or dead by a court;
ekb-uffea0e72c88a0313a2-1.locator: Article 47. Early termination of the powers of a deputy of the City Duma

ekb-u1ece24b2babbc1fbdd-1.text: 4) entry into legal force of a court judgment convicting them;
ekb-u1ece24b2babbc1fbdd-1.locator: Article 47. Early termination of the powers of a deputy of the City Duma

ekb-u5067d2a25b3ef821e2-1.text: 5) departure from the Russian Federation for permanent residence abroad;
ekb-u5067d2a25b3ef821e2-1.locator: Article 47. Early termination of the powers of a deputy of the City Duma

ekb-ub62dffcb065861b3e8-1.text: 6) termination of citizenship of the Russian Federation or citizenship of a foreign state that is a party to an international treaty of the Russian Federation under which a foreign citizen has the right to be elected to local self-government bodies; possession of citizenship (nationality) of a foreign state or of a residence permit or other document confirming the right of a citizen of the Russian Federation, or of a foreign citizen entitled under an international treaty of the Russian Federation to be elected to local self-government bodies, to permanent residence in a foreign state, unless otherwise provided for by an international treaty of the Russian Federation;
ekb-ub62dffcb065861b3e8-1.locator: Article 47. Early termination of the powers of a deputy of the City Duma

ekb-ub1149363ad06c0f5d7-1.text: 7) deleted. — Decision of the Yekaterinburg City Duma of 25.10.2011 No. 67/47;
ekb-ub1149363ad06c0f5d7-1.locator: Article 47. Early termination of the powers of a deputy of the City Duma

ekb-u0152c8baa76467749e-1.text: 8) early termination of the powers of the City Duma;
ekb-u0152c8baa76467749e-1.locator: Article 47. Early termination of the powers of a deputy of the City Duma

ekb-u39b5d1cf72c75e48cc-1.text: 9) holding a post or carrying out activities incompatible with the status of a deputy of the City Duma;
ekb-u39b5d1cf72c75e48cc-1.locator: Article 47. Early termination of the powers of a deputy of the City Duma

ekb-u2f8edf34b3e1e90005-1.text: 10) conscription for military service or assignment to alternative civilian service replacing it;
ekb-u2f8edf34b3e1e90005-1.locator: Article 47. Early termination of the powers of a deputy of the City Duma

ekb-u6ef5ba1ded1415563a-1.locator: Article 47. Early termination of the powers of a deputy of the City Duma

ekb-ue3141451e4252d9a6c-1.locator: Article 47. Early termination of the powers of a deputy of the City Duma

ekb-u2bb7e5a4e17d6846bc-1.text: 12) other cases established by federal laws.
ekb-u2bb7e5a4e17d6846bc-1.locator: Article 47. Early termination of the powers of a deputy of the City Duma

ekb-u0bf83d7b4c9617bf58-1.text: The powers of a deputy of the City Duma terminate early by a decision of the City Duma if the deputy is absent without valid reasons from all meetings of the City Duma for six consecutive months.
ekb-u0bf83d7b4c9617bf58-1.locator: Article 47. Early termination of the powers of a deputy of the City Duma

ekb-ua5c607a1ed127d2d16-1.text: 1-1. A decision of the City Duma on early termination of the powers of a deputy of the City Duma is adopted no later than 30 days after the ground for early termination arises; if that ground arises between sessions of the City Duma, the decision is adopted no later than three months after the ground arises.
ekb-ua5c607a1ed127d2d16-1.locator: Article 47. Early termination of the powers of a deputy of the City Duma

ekb-u646fa2e405019cef6c-1.text: 2. A decision on early termination of the powers of a deputy of the City Duma on the grounds provided for in subpoints 1 and 9 of point 1 of this Article of the Charter is adopted by the City Duma on the basis of the deputy’s written application.
ekb-u646fa2e405019cef6c-1.locator: Article 47. Early termination of the powers of a deputy of the City Duma

ekb-ub8dec2d4e360cdf284-1.text: 3. In the event of early termination of the powers of a deputy of the City Duma, municipal by-elections are held according to the procedure and within the time limits established by electoral legislation.
ekb-ub8dec2d4e360cdf284-1.locator: Article 47. Early termination of the powers of a deputy of the City Duma

ekb-u11a9a719a036d08bb5-1.text: 1. Municipal legal acts on matters of local significance are adopted directly by the population of the municipality and by local self-government bodies and officials.

ekb-ubc261ee25c72f07617-1.text: 2. On matters concerning the exercise of specific state powers transferred to local self-government bodies by federal laws or laws of Sverdlovsk Oblast, municipal legal acts may be adopted on the basis of, and to implement, provisions established by the corresponding federal laws or laws of Sverdlovsk Oblast.

ekb-u01ec2a5da04d3aa615-1.text: 3. Municipal legal acts adopted by the population and local self-government bodies and officials are binding throughout the territory of the municipality.

ekb-u15bf15e5559df8f89c-1.text: Citizens, heads of organizations and officials of state authorities and local self-government bodies bear liability for failure to comply with municipal legal acts in accordance with federal law and the law of Sverdlovsk Oblast.

ekb-ub970e0413aa9b09133-1.text: 4. Municipal legal acts adopted by the population and local self-government bodies and officials must not contradict the Constitution of the Russian Federation, federal constitutional laws, federal laws and laws of Sverdlovsk Oblast, or other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation and Sverdlovsk Oblast.

ekb-u3bab713407b639233c-1.text: 5. Municipal legal acts may be repealed or their operation suspended by the local self-government bodies or officials that adopted (issued) the corresponding act; where such bodies or offices have been abolished or the list of their powers has changed, by the local self-government bodies or officials whose powers, at the time of repeal or suspension, include adopting (issuing) the corresponding municipal legal act; and also by a court. Insofar as an act regulates the exercise by local self-government bodies of specific state powers transferred to them by federal laws and laws of Sverdlovsk Oblast, it may also be repealed or suspended by an authorized state authority of the Russian Federation (an authorized state authority of Sverdlovsk Oblast).

ekb-u2a134c93cd368dae36-1.text: 6. Municipal normative legal acts, including decisions adopted at a local referendum (citizens’ assembly) and formalized as legal acts, must be included in the register of municipal normative legal acts of Sverdlovsk Oblast.

ekb-u668ba62b18c363af50-1.text: Article 49. System of municipal legal acts
ekb-u668ba62b18c363af50-1.locator: Article 49. System of municipal legal acts

ekb-u759c2bf3d3ceaaf212-1.text: 1. The system of municipal legal acts consists of:
ekb-u759c2bf3d3ceaaf212-1.locator: Article 49. System of municipal legal acts

ekb-ufcca1286f6effdd691-1.text: 1) the Charter of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg” and decisions adopted at a local referendum and formalized as legal acts;
ekb-ufcca1286f6effdd691-1.locator: Article 49. System of municipal legal acts

ekb-u34888c3894f9a11c30-1.locator: Article 49. System of municipal legal acts

ekb-u1dc9e8117c8a63e601-1.text: 3) resolutions and executive orders of the Head of Yekaterinburg;
ekb-u1dc9e8117c8a63e601-1.locator: Article 49. System of municipal legal acts

ekb-u7af184b9fc5c499c2b-1.text: 4) resolutions and executive orders of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg;
ekb-u7af184b9fc5c499c2b-1.locator: Article 49. System of municipal legal acts

ekb-ud9c813421a7f2f2dcf-1.text: 5) executive orders and administrative orders of other officials of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg provided for by this Charter;
ekb-ud9c813421a7f2f2dcf-1.locator: Article 49. System of municipal legal acts

ekb-u7a0e7942101159737a-1.text: 6) resolutions and executive orders of the Chamber of Accounts;
ekb-u7a0e7942101159737a-1.locator: Article 49. System of municipal legal acts

ekb-ubdb8e48c415da44145-1.text: 7) resolutions and executive orders of the Chair of the City Duma.
ekb-ubdb8e48c415da44145-1.locator: Article 49. System of municipal legal acts

ekb-u3abe528f8fc923d7ab-1.text: 2. The Charter of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg” and decisions adopted at a local referendum and formalized as legal acts have the highest legal force within the system of municipal legal acts, have direct effect and apply throughout the territory of the municipality.
ekb-u3abe528f8fc923d7ab-1.locator: Article 49. System of municipal legal acts

ekb-u63f5baa03a57c9a24b-1.text: 3. Other municipal legal acts must not contradict this Charter or legal acts adopted at a local referendum.
ekb-u63f5baa03a57c9a24b-1.locator: Article 49. System of municipal legal acts

ekb-u0db5d23d78722744df-1.text: 4. Draft municipal legal acts may be introduced by the Head of Yekaterinburg, deputies of the City Duma, the Chamber of Accounts, bodies of territorial public self-government, the prosecutor of the City of Yekaterinburg and citizens’ initiative groups.
ekb-u0db5d23d78722744df-1.locator: Article 49. System of municipal legal acts

ekb-u4f015982511b91fc02-1.text: 5. The procedure for introducing draft municipal legal acts and the list and form of accompanying documents are established by the Head of Yekaterinburg and the City Duma to whom such drafts are submitted for consideration.
ekb-u4f015982511b91fc02-1.locator: Article 49. System of municipal legal acts

ekb-u59c7eb32469adc920f-1.text: Article 50. Entry into force and promulgation of municipal legal acts
ekb-u59c7eb32469adc920f-1.locator: Article 50. Entry into force and promulgation of municipal legal acts

ekb-uaa9a02d63dd0ccdff9-1.text: 1. Municipal legal acts enter into force according to the procedure established by this Charter, except for decisions of the City Duma on taxes and levies, which enter into force in accordance with the Tax Code of the Russian Federation.
ekb-uaa9a02d63dd0ccdff9-1.locator: Article 50. Entry into force and promulgation of municipal legal acts

ekb-u05e8119b16645c9c7a-1.text: 2. Municipal normative legal acts affecting human and civil rights, freedoms and duties, municipal normative legal acts establishing the legal status of organizations founded by the municipality, and agreements concluded between local self-government bodies enter into force after their official promulgation.
ekb-u05e8119b16645c9c7a-1.locator: Article 50. Entry into force and promulgation of municipal legal acts

ekb-u90f7dc4c7713cc3708-1.text: 3. Promulgation of a municipal legal act, including an agreement concluded between local self-government bodies, means:
ekb-u90f7dc4c7713cc3708-1.locator: Article 50. Entry into force and promulgation of municipal legal acts

ekb-u3c73845ca1568354bf-1.text: 1) official publication of the municipal legal act;
ekb-u3c73845ca1568354bf-1.locator: Article 50. Entry into force and promulgation of municipal legal acts

ekb-u6b9f4e686070e3d077-1.text: 2) placing the municipal legal act in locations accessible to an unrestricted range of persons (premises of state bodies, local self-government bodies, state and municipal libraries, and other places open to visitors);
ekb-u6b9f4e686070e3d077-1.locator: Article 50. Entry into force and promulgation of municipal legal acts

ekb-uf8daf99f61372b51f5-1.text: 3) posting it on the municipality’s official website on the Internet information and telecommunications network.
ekb-uf8daf99f61372b51f5-1.locator: Article 50. Entry into force and promulgation of municipal legal acts

ekb-u061b73d03c6354e6eb-1.text: 4. Official publication of a municipal legal act, including an agreement concluded between local self-government bodies, is its first full-text publication in the ‘Bulletin of the Yekaterinburg City Duma’ or the ‘Yekaterinburg Bulletin’.
ekb-u061b73d03c6354e6eb-1.locator: Article 50. Entry into force and promulgation of municipal legal acts

ekb-ud6824c337706c4cdeb-1.text: 5. In accordance with federal legislation, municipal legal acts or individual provisions thereof containing information whose dissemination is restricted by federal law are not subject to promulgation.
ekb-ud6824c337706c4cdeb-1.locator: Article 50. Entry into force and promulgation of municipal legal acts

ekb-u2ff7a2ea9642c15a45-1.text: Municipal legal acts or individual provisions thereof that are not subject to promulgation under the first paragraph of this point must be communicated to the local self-government bodies, their officials and organizations to which those municipal legal acts apply.
ekb-u2ff7a2ea9642c15a45-1.locator: Article 50. Entry into force and promulgation of municipal legal acts

ekb-u2271deefb9ed0120af-1.text: 6. Non-normative municipal legal acts may be promulgated by a decision of the municipality’s local self-government bodies and officials that adopted (issued) them.
ekb-u2271deefb9ed0120af-1.locator: Article 50. Entry into force and promulgation of municipal legal acts

ekb-u8270c8492fde0a781e-1.text: 7. If implementing a decision adopted through the direct expression of will of the municipality’s population additionally requires adoption (issuance) of a municipal legal act, the City Duma or the Head of Yekaterinburg whose competence includes adopting (issuing) that act must, within 15 days after the decision adopted at the local referendum enters into force, determine the time limit for preparing and adopting the corresponding municipal legal act. That time limit may not exceed three months.
ekb-u8270c8492fde0a781e-1.locator: Article 50. Entry into force and promulgation of municipal legal acts

ekb-ud2413ea307ba94a104-1.text: Article 51. Charter of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”
ekb-ud2413ea307ba94a104-1.locator: Article 51. Charter of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”

ekb-u3325a6069a4ca02cea-1.text: 1. In accordance with federal legislation, the Charter of the municipality determines:
ekb-u3325a6069a4ca02cea-1.locator: Article 51. Charter of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”

ekb-uc2b54cb7a93f3fc1d0-1.locator: Article 51. Charter of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”

ekb-ud8f55c306016e1ff47-1.text: 2) the list of matters of local significance;
ekb-ud8f55c306016e1ff47-1.locator: Article 51. Charter of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”

ekb-u45f666c243963ed835-1.text: 3) the forms, procedure and guarantees of public participation in resolving matters of local significance, including through the formation of territorial public self-government bodies;
ekb-u45f666c243963ed835-1.locator: Article 51. Charter of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”

ekb-u6141209a40c475a42d-1.text: 4) the structure and procedure for forming local self-government bodies;
ekb-u6141209a40c475a42d-1.locator: Article 51. Charter of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”

ekb-u2ddb33066b2c191254-1.text: 5) the names and powers of elected and other local self-government bodies and local self-government officials;
ekb-u2ddb33066b2c191254-1.locator: Article 51. Charter of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”

ekb-u69ac4d4393a06b376a-1.text: 6) the types of municipal legal acts and the procedures for their adoption (issuance), official publication (promulgation) and entry into force;
ekb-u69ac4d4393a06b376a-1.locator: Article 51. Charter of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”

ekb-uca01f0c109a6172dfc-1.text: 7) the terms of office of the City Duma, the Head of Yekaterinburg and deputies of the City Duma, and the grounds and procedure for termination of their powers;
ekb-uca01f0c109a6172dfc-1.locator: Article 51. Charter of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”

ekb-u894eb7ea58d04415c1-1.text: 8) the types of liability of the City Duma, the Head of Yekaterinburg and deputies of the City Duma, the grounds for such liability and the procedure for resolving the corresponding matters;
ekb-u894eb7ea58d04415c1-1.locator: Article 51. Charter of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”

ekb-u4551df211cbfe68d07-1.text: 9) the procedure for preparing and considering the draft municipal budget, approving and executing the municipal budget, monitoring its execution, and preparing and approving the report on execution of the municipal budget in accordance with the Budget Code of the Russian Federation;
ekb-u4551df211cbfe68d07-1.locator: Article 51. Charter of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”

ekb-ue3a0ef81bb5557172e-1.text: 10) the procedure for amending and supplementing this Charter;
ekb-ue3a0ef81bb5557172e-1.locator: Article 51. Charter of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”

ekb-u83d9529fe07e11e736-1.text: 11) other matters concerning the organization of local self-government in accordance with federal and oblast legislation.
ekb-u83d9529fe07e11e736-1.locator: Article 51. Charter of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”

ekb-u8efa6b60fe73f4d754-1.text: 2. The Charter of the municipality and a decision to amend and supplement it are adopted by the City Duma by a two-thirds majority of the established number of deputies of the City Duma.
ekb-u8efa6b60fe73f4d754-1.locator: Article 51. Charter of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”

ekb-ub81088fd9c44e041f6-1.text: 3. The draft Charter of the municipality and a draft decision of the City Duma to amend and supplement it must be officially published (promulgated) no later than 30 days before consideration of the adoption of the Charter or amendments and additions to it, together with publication (promulgation) of the procedure established by the City Duma for taking account of proposals on those drafts and for citizens’ participation in their discussion.
ekb-ub81088fd9c44e041f6-1.locator: Article 51. Charter of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”

ekb-u6ef161f1f365e516f6-1.text: Official publication (promulgation) of the procedure for taking account of proposals on a draft decision of the City Duma to amend and supplement the Charter of the municipality and the procedure for citizens’ participation in its discussion is not required where amendments to the Charter exactly reproduce provisions of the Constitution of the Russian Federation, federal laws, the Charter or laws of Sverdlovsk Oblast in order to bring the Charter of the municipality into conformity with those normative legal acts.
ekb-u6ef161f1f365e516f6-1.locator: Article 51. Charter of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”

ekb-u0e0b7d2ebd2b0576f7-1.text: 4. The Charter of the municipality and decisions on amendments and additions to it are subject to state registration.
ekb-u0e0b7d2ebd2b0576f7-1.locator: Article 51. Charter of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”

ekb-u42ba832b6e30d78a13-1.text: 5. The Charter of the municipality and a decision to amend and supplement it must be officially published (promulgated) after state registration and enter into force after their official publication (promulgation). The Head of Yekaterinburg must publish (promulgate) the registered Charter and decision to amend and supplement it within seven days after receipt, from the territorial body of the authorized federal executive body responsible for registration of municipal charters, of the notification provided for in part 6 of Article 4 of Federal Law of 21 July 2005 No. 97-ФЗ ‘On State Registration of Municipal Charters’, confirming the inclusion of information on the municipal charter and the municipal legal act amending it in the State Register of Municipal Charters of Sverdlovsk Oblast.
ekb-u42ba832b6e30d78a13-1.locator: Article 51. Charter of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”

ekb-u1caa1200951fe27244-1.text: 6. Amendments and additions to the Charter of the municipality that change the structure of local self-government bodies or the allocation of powers between them (except where the Charter is brought into conformity with federal laws, or the powers, term of office or procedure for electing the Head of Yekaterinburg are changed) enter into force after the expiry of the term of office of the City Duma that adopted the decision on those amendments and additions, unless otherwise provided for by Federal Law of 6 October 2003 No. 131-ФЗ ‘On the General Principles of the Organization of Local Self-Government in the Russian Federation’.
ekb-u1caa1200951fe27244-1.locator: Article 51. Charter of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”

ekb-u2a1b0d5d2f902ca420-1.text: 6-1. Amendments and additions to the Charter of the municipality are made by a municipal legal act — a decision of the City Duma signed by the Head of Yekaterinburg and the Chair of the City Duma.
ekb-u2a1b0d5d2f902ca420-1.locator: Article 51. Charter of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”

ekb-u1ecadf4c771efa6188-1.text: 6-2. Restating the Charter of the municipality in a new version by adopting a decision of the City Duma on amendments and additions to the Charter is not permitted.
ekb-u1ecadf4c771efa6188-1.locator: Article 51. Charter of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”

ekb-ub52b3b736ca496a698-1.text: 7. The Charter of the municipality and amendments and additions to it are kept by the Head of Yekaterinburg.
ekb-ub52b3b736ca496a698-1.locator: Article 51. Charter of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”

ekb-u2ca9a375f593eaf91b-1.text: Article 52. Legal acts of the City Duma
ekb-u2ca9a375f593eaf91b-1.locator: Article 52. Legal acts of the City Duma

ekb-ub374075073dedb9724-1.text: 1. On matters assigned to its competence by federal laws, laws of Sverdlovsk Oblast and this Charter, the City Duma adopts decisions establishing rules binding within the municipality, a decision dismissing the Head of Yekaterinburg from office, and decisions on the organization of the City Duma’s activities and other matters assigned to its competence by federal laws, laws of Sverdlovsk Oblast and this Charter. Decisions are adopted at meetings of the City Duma by open voting, including roll-call voting, or by secret ballot.
ekb-ub374075073dedb9724-1.locator: Article 52. Legal acts of the City Duma

ekb-u0124340694343fc73d-1.text: 2. The procedures for preparing, introducing, considering and adopting decisions of the City Duma and sending them for publication (promulgation) are determined by this Charter and decisions of the City Duma.
ekb-u0124340694343fc73d-1.locator: Article 52. Legal acts of the City Duma

ekb-u21f33cd15e85ea4667-1.text: 3. Decisions of the City Duma providing for the establishment, amendment or abolition of local taxes and levies or expenditure from the local budget may be submitted for the City Duma’s consideration only on the initiative of the Head of Yekaterinburg or with an opinion from the Head of Yekaterinburg.
ekb-u21f33cd15e85ea4667-1.locator: Article 52. Legal acts of the City Duma

ekb-u031b8f2ad901978732-1.text: 4. Decisions of the City Duma establishing rules binding within the municipality and signed by the Chair of the City Duma are sent to the Head of Yekaterinburg no later than 2 days after their adoption for signature and promulgation within 10 days after their adoption.
ekb-u031b8f2ad901978732-1.locator: Article 52. Legal acts of the City Duma

ekb-uf00bd1d3a7e548a3ca-1.text: 5. The Head of Yekaterinburg has the right to reject a decision of the City Duma.
ekb-uf00bd1d3a7e548a3ca-1.locator: Article 52. Legal acts of the City Duma

ekb-ua7a52d290f1878914d-1.text: In that case, the decision is returned to the City Duma within 10 days with a reasoned justification for its rejection or proposals for amendments and additions. If the Head of Yekaterinburg rejects a decision, it is reconsidered by the City Duma. If, upon reconsideration, the decision is approved in its previously adopted wording by a majority of at least two thirds of the established number of deputies of the City Duma, it must be signed by the Head of Yekaterinburg within seven days and promulgated.
ekb-ua7a52d290f1878914d-1.locator: Article 52. Legal acts of the City Duma

ekb-u73c3def1448312141b-1.text: 6. The Head of Yekaterinburg may use an electronic signature to sign decisions of the City Duma according to the procedure determined by federal law.
ekb-u73c3def1448312141b-1.locator: Article 52. Legal acts of the City Duma

ekb-ue4127b96d11b5a0325-1.text: 7. Decisions of the City Duma establishing rules binding within the municipality are sent for publication within 5 days after signature by the Head of Yekaterinburg and enter into force upon expiry of 10 days from the date of their official publication in the ‘Bulletin of the Yekaterinburg City Duma’, unless federal or oblast legislation or the decisions themselves specify other dates for entry into force.
ekb-ue4127b96d11b5a0325-1.locator: Article 52. Legal acts of the City Duma

ekb-ua28162c65777d67821-1.text: Official publication of a decision of the City Duma establishing rules binding within the municipality is its first full-text publication in the ‘Bulletin of the Yekaterinburg City Duma’.
ekb-ua28162c65777d67821-1.locator: Article 52. Legal acts of the City Duma

ekb-uac08db6dff79f0c52b-1.text: 8. Decisions of the City Duma on the organization of its activities and non-normative decisions of the City Duma are signed by the Chair of the City Duma within 5 days after adoption and enter into force on the day of signature, unless federal legislation, legislation of Sverdlovsk Oblast or the decisions themselves specify other dates for entry into force. In cases established by decisions of the City Duma, decisions on the organization of its activities and non-normative decisions of the City Duma are published in the ‘Bulletin of the Yekaterinburg City Duma’ or another printed publication designated by the City Duma.
ekb-uac08db6dff79f0c52b-1.locator: Article 52. Legal acts of the City Duma

ekb-u2f57599de7d2ca865a-1.text: Article 53. Legal acts of the Head of Yekaterinburg and the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg
ekb-u2f57599de7d2ca865a-1.locator: Article 53. Legal acts of the Head of Yekaterinburg and the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u0cae40fe1b7e4791c1-1.text: 1. The Head of Yekaterinburg issues resolutions and executive orders of the Head of Yekaterinburg on matters assigned to their competence by this Charter in accordance with Federal Law of 6 October 2003 No. 131-ФЗ ‘On the General Principles of the Organization of Local Self-Government in the Russian Federation’ and other federal laws.
ekb-u0cae40fe1b7e4791c1-1.locator: Article 53. Legal acts of the Head of Yekaterinburg and the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg

ekb-ua90e0e3dbd95f32a7b-1.text: 2. In exercising the powers of the head of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg, the Head of Yekaterinburg issues:
ekb-ua90e0e3dbd95f32a7b-1.locator: Article 53. Legal acts of the Head of Yekaterinburg and the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u029fabe899acfab3a1-1.text: resolutions of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg — on matters of local significance and matters related to the exercise of specific state powers transferred to local self-government bodies by federal laws and laws of Sverdlovsk Oblast;
ekb-u029fabe899acfab3a1-1.locator: Article 53. Legal acts of the Head of Yekaterinburg and the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg

ekb-ucfeb4832cf842fa335-1.text: executive orders of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg — on the organization of the work of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg.
ekb-ucfeb4832cf842fa335-1.locator: Article 53. Legal acts of the Head of Yekaterinburg and the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u734db2aa604972d079-1.text: 3. Normative resolutions of the Head of Yekaterinburg and the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg are sent for official publication within five days after signature and enter into force upon expiry of 10 days after the day of their official publication in the ‘Yekaterinburg Bulletin’, unless the resolutions themselves specify other dates for entry into force.
ekb-u734db2aa604972d079-1.locator: Article 53. Legal acts of the Head of Yekaterinburg and the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u0cc2ca26daee6ca50c-1.text: 4. Non-normative resolutions and executive orders of the Head of Yekaterinburg and the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg enter into force after signature, unless the resolutions and executive orders themselves specify other dates for entry into force.
ekb-u0cc2ca26daee6ca50c-1.locator: Article 53. Legal acts of the Head of Yekaterinburg and the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg

ekb-ub3b794da5f517298d1-1.text: 5. The Head of Yekaterinburg may use an electronic signature to sign legal acts according to the procedure provided for by federal law.
ekb-ub3b794da5f517298d1-1.locator: Article 53. Legal acts of the Head of Yekaterinburg and the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg

ekb-uf5cfa63386e6b80ce3-1.text: Article 53-1. Repealed. — Decision of the Yekaterinburg City Duma of 25.05.2018 No. 11/81.
ekb-uf5cfa63386e6b80ce3-1.locator: Article 53. Legal acts of the Head of Yekaterinburg and the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg

ekb-u906ae8e3369d71be4b-1.text: Chapter VIII. ECONOMIC BASIS OF LOCAL SELF-GOVERNMENT
ekb-u906ae8e3369d71be4b-1.locator: Chapter VIII. ECONOMIC BASIS OF LOCAL SELF-GOVERNMENT

ekb-u575edf2283e1b5d671-2.locator: Chapter VIII. ECONOMIC BASIS OF LOCAL SELF-GOVERNMENT

ekb-u84f247e5d4b2778e6e-1.text: Article 54. Economic basis of local self-government of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”
ekb-u84f247e5d4b2778e6e-1.locator: Article 54. Economic basis of local self-government of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”

ekb-uc20b0281229ba0dc69-1.text: 1. The economic basis of local self-government in the municipality consists of municipal budget funds, the municipality’s property rights and municipally owned property intended for resolving matters of local significance and supporting the activities of local self-government bodies and officials, municipal servants and employees of municipal enterprises and institutions; property intended for exercising specific state powers transferred to local self-government bodies in cases established by federal laws and laws of Sverdlovsk Oblast; and property necessary for resolving matters that local self-government bodies are entitled by federal laws to resolve and that are not classified as matters of local significance.
ekb-uc20b0281229ba0dc69-1.locator: Article 54. Economic basis of local self-government of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”

ekb-u4f88c42efc47604ea6-1.text: 2. Municipal ownership is recognized and protected by the state on an equal basis with other forms of ownership.
ekb-u4f88c42efc47604ea6-1.locator: Article 54. Economic basis of local self-government of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”

ekb-u09bea8994207d16340-1.text: Article 55. Possession, use and disposal of municipal property
ekb-u09bea8994207d16340-1.locator: Article 55. Possession, use and disposal of municipal property

ekb-u43d348429debdee6e8-1.text: 1. The Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg and, within its powers, the City Duma possess, use and dispose of municipally owned property on behalf of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg” in accordance with federal legislation, this Charter and their normative legal acts.
ekb-u43d348429debdee6e8-1.locator: Article 55. Possession, use and disposal of municipal property

ekb-ud77ababd84834fcacf-1.text: 2. The Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg may exercise the powers of a member of business companies on behalf of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg” in accordance with civil legislation, transfer municipally owned property for temporary or permanent use to individuals and legal entities, state authorities of the Russian Federation (state authorities of Sverdlovsk Oblast) and local self-government bodies of other municipalities, alienate such property and enter into other transactions in accordance with federal legislation.
ekb-ud77ababd84834fcacf-1.locator: Article 55. Possession, use and disposal of municipal property

ekb-u4c131bb82268f50dd0-1.text: 3. Revenue from the use and privatization of municipally owned property is paid into the municipal budget.
ekb-u4c131bb82268f50dd0-1.locator: Article 55. Possession, use and disposal of municipal property

ekb-ubffb2c2fc4570d4c40-1.text: 4. The Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg maintains a register of municipal property according to the procedure established by the federal executive body authorized by the Government of the Russian Federation.
ekb-ubffb2c2fc4570d4c40-1.locator: Article 55. Possession, use and disposal of municipal property

ekb-uff07b3e7c49f535608-1.text: Article 56. Municipal enterprises and municipal institutions
ekb-uff07b3e7c49f535608-1.locator: Article 56. Municipal enterprises and municipal institutions

ekb-ub9f6124b6d88b427c7-1.text: 1. The municipality creates (establishes), reorganizes and liquidates municipal enterprises and municipal institutions according to the established procedure.
ekb-ub9f6124b6d88b427c7-1.locator: Article 56. Municipal enterprises and municipal institutions

ekb-uaf59fdf433d40bfbbf-1.text: 2. The functions and powers of founder in relation to municipal enterprises and municipal institutions are exercised by the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg through its bodies.
ekb-uaf59fdf433d40bfbbf-1.locator: Article 56. Municipal enterprises and municipal institutions

ekb-u3a80e5a834275d37ce-1.text: 3. The procedure for adopting decisions on the establishment, reorganization and liquidation of municipal enterprises is determined by the City Duma on the submission of the Head of Yekaterinburg.
ekb-u3a80e5a834275d37ce-1.locator: Article 56. Municipal enterprises and municipal institutions

ekb-u82968518dd9e5e4ea4-1.text: 4. The procedure for adopting decisions on the establishment, reorganization and liquidation of municipal institutions is determined by the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg.
ekb-u82968518dd9e5e4ea4-1.locator: Article 56. Municipal enterprises and municipal institutions

ekb-u78aca2f03676da334c-1.text: 5. Heads of municipal enterprises and municipal institutions exercise their powers in accordance with the labour legislation of the Russian Federation.
ekb-u78aca2f03676da334c-1.locator: Article 56. Municipal enterprises and municipal institutions

ekb-u69d7cc5cfbfbcf8244-1.text: 6. The Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg, on behalf of the municipality, bears subsidiary liability for the obligations of municipal treasury-funded institutions and ensures their performance according to the procedure established by federal law.
ekb-u69d7cc5cfbfbcf8244-1.locator: Article 56. Municipal enterprises and municipal institutions

ekb-u07f9e56529ff10be45-1.text: 1. The municipality has its own budget intended to fulfil the municipality’s expenditure obligations.

ekb-u80cfdd29fb89ae5803-1.text: 2. Repealed. — Decision of the Yekaterinburg City Duma of 24.05.2011 No. 37/42.

ekb-u67ab891ecbd4f0ae61-1.text: 3. The Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg ensures the preparation of, and prepares, the draft municipal budget (the draft municipal budget and medium-term financial plan), and ensures execution of the municipal budget and preparation of budget reporting.

ekb-ue8cfabe9ddaa2afd67-1.text: 3-1. The financial body of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg directly prepares the draft municipal budget (the draft budget and medium-term financial plan), organizes execution of the municipal budget, establishes the procedure for preparing budget reporting and prepares budget reports, and maintains the municipal debt register.

ekb-u3f51e66b6d3f2823d7-1.text: 4. The City Duma approves the municipal budget by its decision.

ekb-u67e980c48f9d7714b0-1.text: 5. The procedure for preparing, considering, approving and executing the municipal budget is determined by the Regulations on the Budget System and Budget Process in the Municipality approved by the City Duma.

ekb-uaf1442410ec98e85ab-1.text: 6. The draft municipal budget, the decision approving the municipal budget, the annual report on its execution, and quarterly information on the progress of municipal budget execution and the numbers of municipal servants in local self-government bodies and employees of municipal institutions, indicating actual expenditure on their remuneration, are subject to official publication.

ekb-u5aee2d2cc4ccc7ec10-1.text: Municipal budget revenue is formed in accordance with the budget legislation of the Russian Federation, legislation on taxes and levies, and legislation on other compulsory payments.

ekb-u6e3ec4dec6272bbc1a-1.text: 1. Municipal budget expenditure is formed in accordance with the municipality’s expenditure obligations established and fulfilled by the municipality’s local self-government bodies in accordance with the requirements of the Budget Code of the Russian Federation.

ekb-u57fe841b6c18fbb4b2-1.text: 2. The municipality’s expenditure obligations are fulfilled from municipal budget funds in accordance with the requirements of the Budget Code of the Russian Federation.

ekb-uefd1e1c3fec416d5cd-1.text: Article 60. Procurement to meet municipal needs
ekb-uefd1e1c3fec416d5cd-1.locator: Article 60. Procurement to meet municipal needs

ekb-u33066a9fcd20e49483-1.text: 1. Procurement of goods, works and services to meet municipal needs is carried out in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation on the contract system in the procurement of goods, works and services to meet state and municipal needs.
ekb-u33066a9fcd20e49483-1.locator: Article 60. Procurement to meet municipal needs

ekb-u664ccf925ec51c8447-1.text: 2. Procurement of goods, works and services to meet municipal needs is funded from the municipal budget.
ekb-u664ccf925ec51c8447-1.locator: Article 60. Procurement to meet municipal needs

ekb-u7c76d73193d6038d60-1.text: 1. The budget process is the activity, regulated by the legislation of the Russian Federation, of state authorities, local self-government bodies and other participants in the budget process in preparing and considering the draft municipal budget, approving and executing the municipal budget, monitoring its execution, maintaining budget accounting, and preparing, externally verifying, considering and approving budget reporting.

ekb-uf30c5be8a93c55f48a-1.text: 2. Participants in the budget process are:

ekb-u784db27e361ce813d3-1.text: the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg;

ekb-ubc152087749d296b0d-1.text: chief spending units (spending units) of budget funds;

ekb-u827387fa258351fef7-1.text: chief administrators (administrators) of sources of financing the budget deficit;

ekb-ue9a6ada6a69d6524b3-1.text: 3. The specific features of the budgetary powers of participants in the budget process are established by the Budget Code of the Russian Federation and municipal legal acts of the City Duma adopted in accordance with it, and, in cases established by them, by municipal legal acts of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg.

ekb-uabd421cd918d605f07-1.text: 1. The list of local taxes and levies is established by the legislation of the Russian Federation on taxes and levies.

ekb-u8926c3894b6ef76748-1.text: 2. Decisions of the City Duma providing for the establishment, amendment or abolition of local taxes and levies are adopted exclusively on the submission of the Head of Yekaterinburg or with an opinion from the Head.

ekb-u1f9f6137c1084a3844-1.text: 3. Revenue from local taxes and levies is credited to the municipal budget at tax rates established by the City Duma in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation on taxes and levies.

ekb-u39a7dec655be4b69dd-1.text: 4. The procedure for introducing local taxes or levies, their duration, tax rates, and the procedure and deadlines for their payment are determined by the City Duma in accordance with legislation.

ekb-u8655ef08b396cf029c-1.text: Article 63. Accounting for and monitoring payment of taxes and levies
ekb-u8655ef08b396cf029c-1.locator: Article 63. Accounting for and monitoring payment of taxes and levies

ekb-ua174cf8c78b0eb40fb-1.text: Accounting for and monitoring payment of taxes and levies into the municipal budget are carried out by the Federal Tax Service; for certain non-tax payments, they are carried out by an authorized body in accordance with an instruction of the Head of Yekaterinburg.
ekb-ua174cf8c78b0eb40fb-1.locator: Article 63. Accounting for and monitoring payment of taxes and levies

ekb-uab3b6acc8b3b94861c-1.text: The Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg” may undertake municipal borrowing, including through the issuance of municipal securities, in accordance with the Budget Code of the Russian Federation and this Charter.

ekb-ucb21c90797de569774-1.text: The Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg organizes and exercises municipal control over compliance with requirements established by municipal legal acts adopted on matters of local significance and, where the relevant types of control are assigned by federal laws to the powers of local self-government bodies, also municipal control over compliance with requirements established by federal laws and laws of Sverdlovsk Oblast.

ekb-u397474d56ed15544ac-1.text: The organization and exercise of types of municipal control are regulated by Federal Law of 31 July 2020 No. 248-ФЗ ‘On State Control (Supervision) and Municipal Control in the Russian Federation’.

ekb-u1eadc934079de6b587-1.text: Municipal control is to be exercised where objects of the corresponding type of control are present within the boundaries of the municipality.

ekb-uc8cdffe0dd1461518b-1.text: The Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg exercises certain types of federal state control (supervision) and regional state control (supervision), powers for the exercise of which have been transferred to the local self-government bodies of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”.

ekb-u4c5921a46cd3b57221-1.text: The Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg is the body authorized to act on behalf of the municipality as the public partner in accordance with Federal Law of 13 July 2015 No. 224-ФЗ ‘On Public-Private Partnership and Municipal-Private Partnership in the Russian Federation and on Amendments to Certain Legislative Acts of the Russian Federation’.

ekb-uff5b1de98dfb2d8810-1.text: Chapter IX. LIABILITY OF BODIES AND OFFICIALS
ekb-uff5b1de98dfb2d8810-1.locator: Chapter IX. LIABILITY OF BODIES AND OFFICIALS

ekb-uf4887d9766e1bd303e-1.text: OF LOCAL SELF-GOVERNMENT OF THE MUNICIPALITY
ekb-uf4887d9766e1bd303e-1.locator: Chapter IX. LIABILITY OF BODIES AND OFFICIALS

ekb-u02d301f77702d9b201-1.text: Article 65. Liability of local self-government bodies and officials
ekb-u02d301f77702d9b201-1.locator: Article 65. Liability of local self-government bodies and officials

ekb-ud274e86aab20bf26ef-1.text: Local self-government bodies and officials bear liability to the population of the municipality, the state, individuals and legal entities in accordance with federal legislation.
ekb-ud274e86aab20bf26ef-1.locator: Article 65. Liability of local self-government bodies and officials

ekb-uc5ba5f7046a98e0bcc-1.text: Article 66. Liability of the Head of Yekaterinburg and the City Duma to the state
ekb-uc5ba5f7046a98e0bcc-1.locator: Article 66. Liability of the Head of Yekaterinburg and the City Duma to the state

ekb-u0c8a9b8f589ae1c09a-1.text: The liability of the Head of Yekaterinburg and the City Duma to the state arises on the basis of a court decision if they violate the Constitution of the Russian Federation, federal constitutional laws, federal laws, the Charter of Sverdlovsk Oblast, laws of Sverdlovsk Oblast or this Charter, or if they improperly exercise specific state powers transferred by federal laws and laws of Sverdlovsk Oblast.
ekb-u0c8a9b8f589ae1c09a-1.locator: Article 66. Liability of the Head of Yekaterinburg and the City Duma to the state

ekb-uab64318a9976862b7d-1.text: The City Duma’s liability to the state also arises, according to the procedure established by federal law, if the City Duma elected (newly elected) with a legally competent composition fails to hold a meeting with the required quorum for three consecutive months.
ekb-uab64318a9976862b7d-1.locator: Article 66. Liability of the Head of Yekaterinburg and the City Duma to the state

ekb-u9cf80703d505794f74-1.text: Article 67. Liability of local self-government bodies, the Head of Yekaterinburg and deputies of the City Duma to the population
ekb-u9cf80703d505794f74-1.locator: Article 67. Liability of local self-government bodies, the Head of Yekaterinburg and deputies of the City Duma to the population

ekb-uea3e76dcfd3cbe35de-1.text: 1. The grounds for liability of local self-government bodies, the Head of Yekaterinburg and a deputy of the City Duma to the population and the procedure for resolving the corresponding matters are determined by federal law and this Charter.
ekb-uea3e76dcfd3cbe35de-1.locator: Article 67. Liability of local self-government bodies, the Head of Yekaterinburg and deputies of the City Duma to the population

ekb-u2d483d0f802399cfec-1.text: 2. The population of the municipality has the right to recall the Head of Yekaterinburg.
ekb-u2d483d0f802399cfec-1.locator: Article 67. Liability of local self-government bodies, the Head of Yekaterinburg and deputies of the City Duma to the population

ekb-u15d0866f8c5c18ee54-1.text: 3. Voting to recall the Head of Yekaterinburg is held on the initiative of the population according to the procedure established by federal law and the law of Sverdlovsk Oblast for conducting a local referendum and by this Charter.
ekb-u15d0866f8c5c18ee54-1.locator: Article 67. Liability of local self-government bodies, the Head of Yekaterinburg and deputies of the City Duma to the population

ekb-ub68ac8b3dd91423140-1.text: 4. In accordance with federal legislation, the Head of Yekaterinburg is considered recalled if at least half of the voters registered in the municipality vote in favour of recall.
ekb-ub68ac8b3dd91423140-1.locator: Article 67. Liability of local self-government bodies, the Head of Yekaterinburg and deputies of the City Duma to the population

ekb-ue52df08d522e4d1744-1.text: Article 68. Liability of local self-government bodies and officials to individuals and legal entities
ekb-ue52df08d522e4d1744-1.locator: Article 68. Liability of local self-government bodies and officials to individuals and legal entities

ekb-u2814349c259f95ce6c-1.text: The liability of the municipality’s local self-government bodies and officials to individuals and legal entities arises according to the procedure established by federal laws.
ekb-u2814349c259f95ce6c-1.locator: Article 68. Liability of local self-government bodies and officials to individuals and legal entities

ekb-u7ea81a31c3cdea0f70-1.text: Chapter X. FINAL AND TRANSITIONAL PROVISIONS
ekb-u7ea81a31c3cdea0f70-1.locator: Chapter X. FINAL AND TRANSITIONAL PROVISIONS

ekb-u5faaa4cc5463068e8a-1.text: Article 69. Entry into force of this Charter
ekb-u5faaa4cc5463068e8a-1.locator: Article 69. Entry into force of this Charter

ekb-u1a1f21676f101bd0a2-1.text: 1. This Charter is subject to state registration and official publication (promulgation) and enters into force on 1 January 2006, except for provisions for which this Article establishes other dates for entry into force.
ekb-u1a1f21676f101bd0a2-1.locator: Article 69. Entry into force of this Charter

ekb-u4a3ae46a6e04d2fea1-1.text: This Article and Article 43 enter into force on the day of official publication (promulgation) of this Charter. Payments established by Article 43 accrue from the day following the day on which the City Duma of the fourth convocation begins its work.
ekb-u4a3ae46a6e04d2fea1-1.locator: Article 69. Entry into force of this Charter

ekb-ubae2f0c228e2985d5c-1.text: Subpoint 39 of point 2 of Article 9 and subpoint 4 of point 1 of Article 9-1 enter into force on 1 January 2008.

ekb-u3a5e0a25b19faf769e-1.text: 2. ekb-u05ef5be536d2f617b0-1.locator: Article 70. Operation of municipal legal acts of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg” until they are brought into conformity with this Charter

ekb-u22e68b2f2d505e576c-1.text: 1. Municipal legal acts in effect before the entry into force of this Charter apply insofar as they do not contradict this Charter.
ekb-u22e68b2f2d505e576c-1.locator: Article 70. Operation of municipal legal acts of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg” until they are brought into conformity with this Charter

ekb-ub52cac68786f9a34a0-1.text: 2. Municipal legal acts must be brought into conformity with this Charter within the time limits established by current legislation.
